title: O3SLM: Open Weight, Open Data, and Open Vocabulary Sketch-Language Model
summary: While Large Vision Language Models (LVLMs) are increasingly deployed in real-world applications, their ability to interpret abstract visual inputs remains limited. Specifically, they struggle to comprehend hand-drawn sketches, a modality that offers an intuitive means of expressing concepts that are difficult to describe textually. We identify the primary bottleneck as the absence of a large-scale dataset that jointly models sketches, photorealistic images, and corresponding natural language instructions. To address this, we present two key contributions: (1) a new, large-scale dataset of image-sketch-instruction triplets designed to facilitate both pretraining and instruction tuning, and (2) O3SLM, an LVLM trained on this dataset. Comprehensive evaluations on multiple sketch-based tasks: (a) object localization, (b) counting, (c) image retrieval i.e., (SBIR and fine-grained SBIR), and (d) visual question answering (VQA); while incorporating the three existing sketch datasets, namely QuickDraw!, Sketchy, and Tu Berlin, along with our generated SketchVCL dataset, show that O3SLM achieves state-of-the-art performance, substantially outperforming existing LVLMs in sketch comprehension and reasoning.

title: Nonholonomic Robot Parking by Feedback -- Part I: Modular Strict CLF Designs
comments: arXiv admin note: text overlap with arXiv:2509.25575
summary: It has been known in the robotics literature since about 1995 that, in polar coordinates, the nonholonomic unicycle is asymptotically stabilizable by smooth feedback, even globally. We introduce a modular design framework that selects the forward velocity to decouple the radial coordinate, allowing the steering subsystem to be stabilized independently. Within this structure, we develop families of feedback laws using passivity, backstepping, and integrator forwarding. Each law is accompanied by a strict control Lyapunov function, including barrier variants that enforce angular constraints. These strict CLFs provide constructive class KL convergence estimates and enable eigenvalue assignment at the target equilibrium. The framework generalizes and extends prior modular and nonmodular approaches, while preparing the ground for inverse optimal and adaptive redesigns in the sequel paper.
comment: arXiv admin note: text overlap with arXiv:2509.25575

title: Complex variational autoencoders admit Kähler structure
summary: It has been discovered that latent-Euclidean variational autoencoders (VAEs) admit, in various capacities, Riemannian structure. We adapt these arguments but for complex VAEs with a complex latent stage. We show that complex VAEs reveal to some level Kähler geometric structure. Our methods will be tailored for decoder geometry. We derive the Fisher information metric in the complex case under a latent complex Gaussian with trivial relation matrix. It is well known from statistical information theory that the Fisher information coincides with the Hessian of the Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence. Thus, the metric Kähler potential relation is exactly achieved under relative entropy. We propose a Kähler potential derivative of complex Gaussian mixtures that acts as a rough proxy to the Fisher information metric while still being faithful to the underlying Kähler geometry. Computation of the metric via this potential is efficient, and through our potential, valid as a plurisubharmonic (PSH) function, large scale computational burden of automatic differentiation is displaced to small scale. Our methods leverage the law of total covariance to bridge behavior between our potential and the Fisher metric. We show that we can regularize the latent space with decoder geometry, and that we can sample in accordance with a weighted complex volume element. We demonstrate these strategies, at the exchange of sample variation, yield consistently smoother representations and fewer semantic outliers.

title: Nonholonomic Robot Parking by Feedback -- Part II: Nonmodular, Inverse Optimal, Adaptive, Prescribed/Fixed-Time and Safe Designs
comments: 16 pages. arXiv admin note: text overlap with arXiv:2509.25563
summary: For the unicycle system, we provide constructive methods for the design of feedback laws that have one or more of the following properties: being nonmodular and globally exponentially stabilizing, inverse optimal, robust to arbitrary decrease or increase of input coefficients, adaptive, prescribed/fixed-time stabilizing, and safe (ensuring the satisfaction of state constraints). Our nonmodular backstepping feedbacks are implementable with either unidirectional or bidirectional velocity actuation. Thanks to constructing families of strict CLFs for the unicycle, we introduce a general design framework and families of feedback laws for the unicycle, which are inverse optimal with respect to meaningful costs. These inverse optimal feedback laws are endowed with robustness to actuator uncertainty and arbitrarily low input saturation due to the unicycle's driftlessness. Besides ensuring robustness to unknown input coefficients, we also develop adaptive laws for these unknown coefficients, enabling the achievement of good transient performance with lower initial control effort. Additionally, we develop controllers that achieve stabilization within a user-specified time horizon using two systematic methods: time-dilated prescribed-time design with smooth-in-time convergence to zero of both the states and the inputs and homogeneity-based fixed-time control that provides an explicit bound on the settling time. Finally, with a nonovershooting design we guarantee strictly forward motion without curb violation. This article, along with its Part I, lays a broad constructive design foundation for stabilization of the nonholonomic unicycle.
comment: 16 pages. arXiv admin note: text overlap with arXiv:2509.25563

title: Learning to Compress: Unlocking the Potential of Large Language Models for Text Representation
summary: Text representation plays a critical role in tasks like clustering, retrieval, and other downstream applications. With the emergence of large language models (LLMs), there is increasing interest in harnessing their capabilities for this purpose. However, most of the LLMs are inherently causal and optimized for next-token prediction, making them suboptimal for producing holistic representations. To address this, recent studies introduced pretext tasks to adapt LLMs for text representation. Most of these tasks, however, rely on token-level prediction objectives, such as the masked next-token prediction (MNTP) used in LLM2Vec. In this work, we explore the untapped potential of context compression as a pretext task for unsupervised adaptation of LLMs. During compression pre-training, the model learns to generate compact memory tokens, which substitute the whole context for downstream sequence prediction. Experiments demonstrate that a well-designed compression objective can significantly enhance LLM-based text representations, outperforming models trained with token-level pretext tasks. Further improvements through contrastive learning produce a strong representation model (LLM2Comp) that outperforms contemporary LLM-based text encoders on a wide range of tasks while being more sample-efficient, requiring significantly less training data. Code is available at https://github.com/longtaizi13579/LLM2Comp.

title: Design and Validation of a Modular Smart Headband with Embroidered Electrodes for Comfortable EEG Monitoring
comments: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication
summary: The wearable EEG device sector is advancing rapidly, enabling fast and reliable detection of brain activity for investigating brain function and pathology. However, many current EEG systems remain challenging for users with neurological conditions due to bulky wiring, lengthy skin preparation, gel-induced discomfort, risk of irritation, and high cost, all of which limit long-term monitoring. This study presents a proof-of-concept smart modular headband incorporating adjustable, replaceable embroidered electrodes for EEG acquisition. Compared with conventional devices, the smart headband reduces wiring complexity, removes the need for skin preparation, and minimizes irritation associated with gel-based electrodes. Its modular structure allows adjustable fitting without requiring multiple size options, enhancing comfort and adaptability for everyday EEG monitoring. The smart headband prototype was tested on 10 healthy university students using three behavioral tasks: (1) eyes open/closed, (2) auditory oddball, and (3) visual oddball paradigms. The smart headband successfully captured alpha peaks during the eyes-open/closed task (p = 0.01) and reliably recorded the event-related potentials associated with the oddball effects - the auditory P300 (p = 0.014) and the visual N170 (p = 0.013) - demonstrating an equivalent performance to a commercial sponge-based EEG cap. A user survey indicated improved comfort and usability, with participants reporting that the soft, structurally designed headband enhanced wearability relative to a conventional cap. Overall, this prototype provides a comfortable, modular, and cost-effective solution to reliable EEG monitoring in real-world applications.
comment: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication

title: AD-R1: Closed-Loop Reinforcement Learning for End-to-End Autonomous Driving with Impartial World Models
summary: End-to-end models for autonomous driving hold the promise of learning complex behaviors directly from sensor data, but face critical challenges in safety and handling long-tail events. Reinforcement Learning (RL) offers a promising path to overcome these limitations, yet its success in autonomous driving has been elusive. We identify a fundamental flaw hindering this progress: a deep seated optimistic bias in the world models used for RL. To address this, we introduce a framework for post-training policy refinement built around an Impartial World Model. Our primary contribution is to teach this model to be honest about danger. We achieve this with a novel data synthesis pipeline, Counterfactual Synthesis, which systematically generates a rich curriculum of plausible collisions and off-road events. This transforms the model from a passive scene completer into a veridical forecaster that remains faithful to the causal link between actions and outcomes. We then integrate this Impartial World Model into our closed-loop RL framework, where it serves as an internal critic. During refinement, the agent queries the critic to ``dream" of the outcomes for candidate actions. We demonstrate through extensive experiments, including on a new Risk Foreseeing Benchmark, that our model significantly outperforms baselines in predicting failures. Consequently, when used as a critic, it enables a substantial reduction in safety violations in challenging simulations, proving that teaching a model to dream of danger is a critical step towards building truly safe and intelligent autonomous agents.

title: Learning to Generate Human-Human-Object Interactions from Textual Descriptions
summary: The way humans interact with each other, including interpersonal distances, spatial configuration, and motion, varies significantly across different situations. To enable machines to understand such complex, context-dependent behaviors, it is essential to model multiple people in relation to the surrounding scene context. In this paper, we present a novel research problem to model the correlations between two people engaged in a shared interaction involving an object. We refer to this formulation as Human-Human-Object Interactions (HHOIs). To overcome the lack of dedicated datasets for HHOIs, we present a newly captured HHOIs dataset and a method to synthesize HHOI data by leveraging image generative models. As an intermediary, we obtain individual human-object interaction (HOIs) and human-human interaction (HHIs) from the HHOIs, and with these data, we train an text-to-HOI and text-to-HHI model using score-based diffusion model. Finally, we present a unified generative framework that integrates the two individual model, capable of synthesizing complete HHOIs in a single advanced sampling process. Our method extends HHOI generation to multi-human settings, enabling interactions involving more than two individuals. Experimental results show that our method generates realistic HHOIs conditioned on textual descriptions, outperforming previous approaches that focus only on single-human HOIs. Furthermore, we introduce multi-human motion generation involving objects as an application of our framework.

title: SingingSDS: A Singing-Capable Spoken Dialogue System for Conversational Roleplay Applications
summary: With recent advances in automatic speech recognition (ASR), large language models (LLMs), and text-to-speech (TTS) technologies, spoken dialogue systems (SDS) have become widely accessible. However, most existing SDS are limited to conventional spoken responses. We present SingingSDS, a cascaded SDS that responds through singing rather than speaking, fostering more affective, memorable, and pleasurable interactions in character-based roleplay and interactive entertainment scenarios. SingingSDS employs a modular ASR-LLM-SVS pipeline and supports a wide range of configurations across character personas, ASR and LLM backends, SVS models, melody sources, and voice profiles, tailored to different needs in terms of latency, quality, and musical style. SingingSDS is available as a plug-and-play web demo, featuring modular, open-source code that supports customization and extension. Demo: https://huggingface.co/spaces/espnet/SingingSDS. Code: https://github.com/SingingSDS/SingingSDS.

title: 47B Mixture-of-Experts Beats 671B Dense Models on Chinese Medical Examinations
summary: The rapid advancement of large language models(LLMs) has prompted significant interest in their potential applications in medical domains. This paper presents a comprehensive benchmark evaluation of 27 state-of-the-art LLMs on Chinese medical examination questions, encompassing seven medical specialties across two professional levels. We introduce a robust evaluation framework that assesses model performance on 2,800 carefully curated questions from cardiovascular, gastroenterology, hematology, infectious diseases, nephrology, neurology, and respiratory medicine domains. Our dataset distinguishes between attending physician and senior physician difficulty levels, providing nuanced insights into model capabilities across varying complexity. Our empirical analysis reveals substantial performance variations among models, with Mixtral-8x7B achieving the highest overall accuracy of 74.25%, followed by DeepSeek-R1-671B at 64.07%. Notably, we observe no consistent correlation between model size and performance, as evidenced by the strong performance of smaller mixture-of-experts architectures. The evaluation demonstrates significant performance gaps between medical specialties, with models generally performing better on cardiovascular and neurology questions compared to gastroenterology and nephrology domains. Furthermore, our analysis indicates minimal performance degradation between attending and senior physician levels for top-performing models, suggesting robust generalization capabilities. This benchmark provides critical insights for the deployment of LLMs in medical education and clinical decision support systems, highlighting both the promise and current limitations of these technologies in specialized medical contexts.

title: On the Incompressibility of Truth With Application to Circuit Complexity
summary: We revisit the fundamentals of Circuit Complexity and the nature of efficient computation from a fresh perspective. We present a framework for understanding Circuit Complexity through the lens of Information Theory with analogies to results in Kolmogorov Complexity, viewing circuits as descriptions of truth tables, encoded in logical gates and wires, rather than purely computational devices. From this framework, we re-prove some existing Circuit Complexity bounds, explain what the optimal circuits for most boolean functions look like structurally, give an explicit boolean function family that requires exponential circuits, and explain the aforementioned results in a unifying intuition that re-frames time entirely.

title: Adaptive Trajectory Bundle Method for Roll-to-Roll Manufacturing Systems
summary: Roll-to-roll (R2R) manufacturing requires precise tension and velocity control under operational constraints. Model predictive control demands gradient computation, while sampling-based methods like MPPI struggle with hard constraint satisfaction. This paper presents an adaptive trajectory bundle method that achieves rigorous constraint handling through derivative-free sequential convex programming. The approach approximates nonlinear dynamics and costs via interpolated sample bundles, replacing Taylor-series linearization with function-value interpolation. Adaptive trust region and penalty mechanisms automatically adjust based on constraint violation metrics, eliminating manual tuning. We establish convergence guarantees proving finite-time feasibility and convergence to stationary points of the constrained problem. Simulations on a six-zone R2R system demonstrate that the adaptive method achieves 4.3\% lower tension RMSE than gradient-based MPC and 11.1\% improvement over baseline TBM in velocity transients, with superior constraint satisfaction compared to MPPI variants. Experimental validation on an R2R dry transfer system confirms faster settling and reduced overshoot relative to LQR and non-adaptive TBM.

title: Closed-Loop Control Law for Low Thrust Orbit Transfer with Guaranteed Stability
comments: 6 pages, 5 figures, 3 tables -- Accepted for publication in Indian Control Conference 2025
summary: Electric propulsion is used to maximize payload capacity in communication satellites. These orbit raising maneuvers span several months and hundreds of revolutions, making trajectory design a complex challenge. The literature typically addresses this problem using feedback laws, with Q-law being one of the most prominent approaches. However, Q-law suffers from closed-loop stability issues, limiting its suitability for real-time on-board implementation. In this work, we focus on closed-loop orbit raising rather than offline trajectory planning and address the stability limitations of the Q-law through a Lyapunov based control design. A Lyapunov-guided modification of the classical Q-law is proposed to ensure closed-loop stability and enable real-time implementation. The effectiveness of the proposed method is demonstrated through closed-loop orbit transfers across various scenarios, including co-planar transfers, equatorial to polar orbit transfers, and geostationary transfer orbit (GTO) to geostationary earth orbit (GEO) transfers.
comment: 6 pages, 5 figures, 3 tables -- Accepted for publication in Indian Control Conference 2025

title: Large Language Model for Verilog Code Generation: Literature Review and the Road Ahead
summary: Code generation has emerged as a critical research area at the intersection of Software Engineering (SE) and Artificial Intelligence (AI), attracting significant attention from both academia and industry. Within this broader landscape, Verilog, as a representative hardware description language (HDL), plays a fundamental role in digital circuit design and verification, making its automated generation particularly significant for Electronic Design Automation (EDA). Consequently, recent research has increasingly focused on applying Large Language Models (LLMs) to Verilog code generation, particularly at the Register Transfer Level (RTL), exploring how these AI-driven techniques can be effectively integrated into hardware design workflows. Despite substantial research efforts have explored LLM applications in this domain, a comprehensive survey synthesizing these developments remains absent from the literature. This review fill addresses this gap by providing a systematic literature review of LLM-based methods for Verilog code generation, examining their effectiveness, limitations, and potential for advancing automated hardware design. The review encompasses research work from conferences and journals in the fields of SE, AI, and EDA, encompassing 70 papers published on venues, along with 32 high-quality preprint papers, bringing the total to 102 papers. By answering four key research questions, we aim to (1) identify the LLMs used for Verilog generation, (2) examine the datasets and metrics employed in evaluation, (3) categorize the techniques proposed for Verilog generation, and (4) analyze LLM alignment approaches for Verilog generation. Based on our findings, we have identified a series of limitations of existing studies. Finally, we have outlined a roadmap highlighting potential opportunities for future research endeavors in LLM-assisted hardware design.

title: ART: Adaptive Response Tuning Framework -- A Multi-Agent Tournament-Based Approach to LLM Response Optimization
comments: 14 pages, 11 figures, 5 tables. IEEE conference-style paper with appendices
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in natural language understanding and generation. However, single-model responses often exhibit inconsistencies, hallucinations, and varying quality across different query domains. This paper presents ART (Adaptive Response Tuning), a novel framework that employs tournament-style ELO ranking and multi-agent reasoning to systematically optimize LLM outputs. By enabling multiple LLM agents to compete, critique, and collaborate through structured tournament workflows, ART produces consensus responses that outperform individual model outputs. Our framework introduces configurable tournament parameters, dynamic agent selection, and multiple consensus fusion strategies. Experimental evaluations demonstrate significant improvements in response accuracy, coherence, and reliability compared to baseline single-model approaches. The ART framework provides a scalable, production-ready solution for applications requiring high-quality, vetted LLM responses, achieving an 8.4% improvement in overall quality metrics and R^2 values exceeding 0.96 in ELO rating convergence.
comment: 14 pages, 11 figures, 5 tables. IEEE conference-style paper with appendices

title: TrackNetV5: Residual-Driven Spatio-Temporal Refinement and Motion Direction Decoupling for Fast Object Tracking
summary: The TrackNet series has established a strong baseline for fast-moving small object tracking in sports. However, existing iterations face significant limitations: V1-V3 struggle with occlusions due to a reliance on purely visual cues, while TrackNetV4, despite introducing motion inputs, suffers from directional ambiguity as its absolute difference method discards motion polarity. To overcome these bottlenecks, we propose TrackNetV5, a robust architecture integrating two novel mechanisms. First, to recover lost directional priors, we introduce the Motion Direction Decoupling (MDD) module. Unlike V4, MDD decomposes temporal dynamics into signed polarity fields, explicitly encoding both movement occurrence and trajectory direction. Second, we propose the Residual-Driven Spatio-Temporal Refinement (R-STR) head. Operating on a coarse-to-fine paradigm, this Transformer-based module leverages factorized spatio-temporal contexts to estimate a corrective residual, effectively recovering occluded targets. Extensive experiments on the TrackNetV2 dataset demonstrate that TrackNetV5 achieves a new state-of-the-art F1-score of 0.9859 and an accuracy of 0.9733, significantly outperforming previous versions. Notably, this performance leap is achieved with a marginal 3.7% increase in FLOPs compared to V4, maintaining real-time inference capabilities while delivering superior tracking precision.

title: Data-regularized Reinforcement Learning for Diffusion Models at Scale
summary: Aligning generative diffusion models with human preferences via reinforcement learning (RL) is critical yet challenging. Most existing algorithms are often vulnerable to reward hacking, such as quality degradation, over-stylization, or reduced diversity. Our analysis demonstrates that this can be attributed to the inherent limitations of their regularization, which provides unreliable penalties. We introduce Data-regularized Diffusion Reinforcement Learning (DDRL), a novel framework that uses the forward KL divergence to anchor the policy to an off-policy data distribution. Theoretically, DDRL enables robust, unbiased integration of RL with standard diffusion training. Empirically, this translates into a simple yet effective algorithm that combines reward maximization with diffusion loss minimization. With over a million GPU hours of experiments and ten thousand double-blind human evaluations, we demonstrate on high-resolution video generation tasks that DDRL significantly improves rewards while alleviating the reward hacking seen in baselines, achieving the highest human preference and establishing a robust and scalable paradigm for diffusion post-training.

title: Has ACL Lost Its Crown? A Decade-Long Quantitative Analysis of Scale and Impact Across Leading AI Conferences
summary:
The recent surge of language models (LMs) has rapidly expanded NLP/AI research, driving an exponential rise in submissions and acceptances at major conferences. Yet this growth has been shadowed by escalating concerns over conference quality, such as plagiarism, reviewer inexperience, and collusive bidding. However, existing studies rely largely on qualitative accounts, for example expert interviews and social media discussions, lacking longitudinal empirical evidence.
  To fill this gap, we conduct a ten-year empirical study (2014-2024) spanning seven leading conferences. We build a four-dimensional bibliometric framework covering conference scale, core citation statistics, impact dispersion, and cross-venue and journal influence. Notably, we further propose a metric called Quality-Quantity Elasticity (QQE), which measures the elasticity of citation growth relative to acceptance growth.
  We highlight two key findings. First, conference expansion does not lead to proportional growth in scholarly impact, as QQE consistently declines over time across all venues. Second, ACL has not lost its crown, continuing to outperform other NLP conferences in median citations, milestone contributions, and citation coverage. This study provides the first decade-long, cross-venue empirical evidence on the evolution of major NLP/AI conferences. Our code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/acl-crown-analysis-38D5.

AI.title_translation: ACL是否失去了它的王冠？对领先AI会议规模和影响力的十年期定量分析
AI.tldr: 十年期定量分析显示，尽管会议规模扩大，学术影响力增长不成比例（QQE下降），但ACL仍保持其领先的学术地位。
AI.motivation: 语言模型的兴起导致主要会议的提交和接受量呈指数级增长，引发了对会议质量的担忧（如抄袭、审稿人经验不足等）。现有研究主要依赖定性分析，缺乏长期的实证证据。
AI.method: 进行了跨越七个领先会议的十年期（2014-2024）实证研究。构建了一个四维文献计量框架，涵盖会议规模、核心引用统计、影响分散度以及跨会议和期刊影响力。提出了一种名为“质量-数量弹性”（QQE）的新指标，衡量引文增长相对于接受量增长的弹性。
AI.result: 发现一：会议扩张并未带来学术影响力的同比增长（QQE在所有会议中持续下降）。发现二：ACL没有失去其王冠，在引文中位数、里程碑式贡献和引文覆盖率方面继续优于其他NLP会议。
AI.conclusion: 本研究首次提供了关于主要NLP/AI会议演变的十年期、跨会议的实证证据，填补了现有研究中缺乏长期经验证据的空白。
AI.translation: 近年来语言模型（LMs）的激增迅速扩大了NLP/AI研究领域，推动了主要会议投稿量和接受量的指数级增长。然而，这种增长伴随着对会议质量日益升级的担忧，例如抄袭、审稿人经验不足和串通投标。现有研究主要依赖定性描述，例如专家访谈和社交媒体讨论，缺乏长期的经验证据。为了填补这一空白，我们进行了一项跨越七个领先会议的十年期（2014-2024）实证研究。我们构建了一个四维文献计量框架，涵盖会议规模、核心引用统计、影响分散度以及跨会议和期刊影响力。值得注意的是，我们进一步提出了一种称为“质量-数量弹性”（QQE）的指标，用于衡量引文增长相对于接受量增长的弹性。我们强调了两个关键发现。首先，会议扩张并未导致学术影响力的同比增长，因为QQE在所有会议中都随着时间持续下降。其次，ACL没有失去其王冠，在引文中位数、里程碑式贡献和引文覆盖率方面继续优于其他NLP会议。本研究首次提供了关于主要NLP/AI会议演变的十年期、跨会议的实证证据。我们的代码可在https://anonymous.4open.science/r/acl-crown-analysis-38D5获取。
AI.summary: 本研究针对语言模型驱动下AI/NLP会议规模激增及其引发的质量担忧，进行了跨越2014年至2024年七个领先会议的十年期实证文献计量分析。研究构建了一个四维框架并提出了“质量-数量弹性”（QQE）指标。主要发现是：会议规模扩张并未带来学术影响力的同比增长（QQE持续下降）；但ACL在引文指标上仍优于其他NLP会议，保持其领先地位。
AI.keywords: ACL会议, 质量-数量弹性 (QQE), 文献计量学, 学术影响力, 会议演变
AI.comments: 本研究的创新点在于其十年期的纵向、跨会议的定量分析，这与此前依赖定性访谈和社交媒体讨论的研究形成了鲜明对比。提出的“质量-数量弹性”（QQE）指标提供了一个量化衡量会议规模增长与学术质量（引文影响力）之间关系的有效工具。研究结果对于会议组织者、研究人员以及资助机构评估大型AI/NLP会议的健康发展和影响力具有重要指导价值。它实证地回答了社区中关于ACL地位和会议质量普遍下降的担忧。

title: STARE-VLA: Progressive Stage-Aware Reinforcement for Fine-Tuning Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Recent advances in Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, powered by large language models and reinforcement learning-based fine-tuning, have shown remarkable progress in robotic manipulation. Existing methods often treat long-horizon actions as linguistic sequences and apply trajectory-level optimization methods such as Trajectory-wise Preference Optimization (TPO) or Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO), leading to coarse credit assignment and unstable training. However, unlike language, where a unified semantic meaning is preserved despite flexible sentence order, action trajectories progress through causally chained stages with different learning difficulties. This motivates progressive stage optimization. Thereby, we present Stage-Aware Reinforcement (STARE), a module that decomposes a long-horizon action trajectory into semantically meaningful stages and provides dense, interpretable, and stage-aligned reinforcement signals. Integrating STARE into TPO and PPO, we yield Stage-Aware TPO (STA-TPO) and Stage-Aware PPO (STA-PPO) for offline stage-wise preference and online intra-stage interaction, respectively. Further building on supervised fine-tuning as initialization, we propose the Imitation -> Preference -> Interaction (IPI), a serial fine-tuning pipeline for improving action accuracy in VLA models. Experiments on SimplerEnv and ManiSkill3 demonstrate substantial gains, achieving state-of-the-art success rates of 98.0 percent on SimplerEnv and 96.4 percent on ManiSkill3 tasks.

AI.title_translation: STARE-VLA：用于微调视觉-语言-动作模型的渐进式阶段感知强化学习
AI.tldr: 现有VLA模型微调不稳定，我们提出STARE（阶段感知强化）模块，将长动作序列分解为语义阶段，提供密集的阶段对齐奖励。结合IPI微调流程（模仿->偏好->交互），显著提高了VLA模型在SimplerEnv和ManiSkill3上的性能，达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有的VLA模型将长周期动作视为语言序列，采用轨迹级优化（如TPO或PPO），导致信用分配粗糙和训练不稳定。动作轨迹是因果链式的阶段，学习难度不同，因此需要渐进式的阶段优化。
AI.method: 提出**STARE（阶段感知强化）**模块，将长动作轨迹分解为有意义的阶段，并提供密集、可解释、阶段对齐的强化信号。将STARE集成到TPO和PPO中，形成了**STA-TPO**和**STA-PPO**。进一步提出了串行微调流程**IPI（模仿 -> 偏好 -> 交互）**，以监督微调作为初始化。
AI.result: 在SimplerEnv和ManiSkill3上取得了显著的提升，成功率分别达到了98.0%和96.4%，达到了现有技术水平（SOTA）。
AI.conclusion: 通过提供阶段感知强化信号，所提出的STARE模块有效地解决了VLA模型中信用分配粗糙的问题。结合IPI串行微调流程（包括STA-TPO和STA-PPO变体），该方法在SimplerEnv和ManiSkill3任务上实现了最先进的成功率。
AI.translation: 最近视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在大型语言模型和基于强化学习的微调的推动下，在机器人操作方面取得了显著进展。现有方法通常将长周期动作视为语言序列，并应用轨迹级优化方法，例如轨迹级偏好优化（TPO）或近端策略优化（PPO），这导致了粗糙的信用分配和不稳定的训练。然而，与语言不同，语言即使句子顺序灵活，也能保持统一的语义意义，而动作轨迹则是通过具有不同学习难度的因果链式阶段推进的。这激发了渐进式阶段优化。因此，我们提出了**阶段感知强化（STARE）**，这是一个将长周期动作轨迹分解为具有语义意义的阶段，并提供密集、可解释、阶段对齐的强化信号的模块。我们将STARE集成到TPO和PPO中，分别产生了**阶段感知TPO（STA-TPO）**用于离线阶段式偏好学习，以及**阶段感知PPO（STA-PPO）**用于在线阶段内交互。在监督微调作为初始化的基础上，我们进一步提出了**模仿 -> 偏好 -> 交互（IPI）**，这是一个用于提高VLA模型动作准确性的串行微调流程。在SimplerEnv和ManiSkill3上的实验证明了显著的增益，成功率分别达到了SimplerEnv上的98.0%和ManiSkill3任务上的96.4%，达到了最先进的水平。
AI.summary: 本文提出了STARE-VLA框架，用于微调视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型。针对现有方法将长动作视为语言序列导致的信用分配粗糙和训练不稳定问题，作者提出了STARE（阶段感知强化）模块，将轨迹分解为语义阶段，并提供密集、阶段对齐的强化信号。该方法采用IPI（模仿 -> 偏好 -> 交互）串行微调流程，并在SimplerEnv和ManiSkill3等机器人操作任务上取得了最先进的成功率。
AI.keywords: 视觉-语言-动作模型, 阶段感知强化, 微调, 机器人操作, 信用分配
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于认识到动作序列与语言序列的根本区别——动作是因果链式的阶段，而非灵活的语义符号。这种见解促成了阶段感知强化（STARE）模块的提出，它显著提高了信用分配的密度和可解释性。结构化的、渐进式的IPI微调流程（模仿 -> 偏好 -> 交互）也是一个关键贡献，它展示了一种实用且高效的方法，可以顺序利用不同类型的强化学习信号来将VLA模型的性能提升至SOTA水平。

title: DEAR: Dataset for Evaluating the Aesthetics of Rendering
summary: Traditional Image Quality Assessment~(IQA) focuses on quantifying technical degradations such as noise, blur, or compression artifacts, using both full-reference and no-reference objective metrics. However, evaluation of rendering aesthetics, a growing domain relevant to photographic editing, content creation, and AI-generated imagery, remains underexplored due to the lack of datasets that reflect the inherently subjective nature of style preference. In this work, a novel benchmark dataset designed to model human aesthetic judgments of image rendering styles is introduced: the Dataset for Evaluating the Aesthetics of Rendering (DEAR). Built upon the MIT-Adobe FiveK dataset, DEAR incorporates pairwise human preference scores collected via large-scale crowdsourcing, with each image pair evaluated by 25 distinct human evaluators with a total of 13,648 of them participating overall. These annotations capture nuanced, context-sensitive aesthetic preferences, enabling the development and evaluation of models that go beyond traditional distortion-based IQA, focusing on a new task: Evaluation of Aesthetics of Rendering (EAR). The data collection pipeline is described, human voting patterns are analyzed, and multiple use cases are outlined, including style preference prediction, aesthetic benchmarking, and personalized aesthetic modeling. To the best of the authors' knowledge, DEAR is the first dataset to systematically address image aesthetics of rendering assessment grounded in subjective human preferences. A subset of 100 images with markup for them is published on HuggingFace (huggingface.co/datasets/vsevolodpl/DEAR).

AI.tldr: 引入了DEAR数据集，这是一个基于MIT-Adobe FiveK、包含大量众包成对偏好评分的新基准，用于评估图像渲染风格的主观美学，支持新的渲染美学评估（EAR）任务。
AI.motivation: 传统的图像质量评估（IQA）侧重于量化技术退化，而渲染美学评估（与摄影编辑和内容创作相关）因缺乏反映风格偏好主观性的数据集而未得到充分探索。
AI.method: 该数据集（DEAR）基于MIT-Adobe FiveK数据集构建，通过大规模众包收集成对的人类偏好评分，每对图像由25位不同的评估者进行评估，总共有13,648人参与。
AI.result: 成功构建了DEAR数据集，该数据集捕获了细致入微、依赖于上下文的美学偏好，并为渲染美学评估（EAR）这一新任务提供了基准。分析了人类的投票模式。
AI.conclusion: DEAR是第一个系统地解决基于主观人类偏好的渲染图像美学评估的数据集。
AI.translation: 传统的图像质量评估（IQA）侧重于使用全参考和无参考客观指标来量化噪声、模糊或压缩伪影等技术退化。然而，渲染美学评估——一个与摄影编辑、内容创作和AI生成图像相关的日益增长的领域——由于缺乏反映风格偏好固有主观性的数据集，仍然未得到充分探索。在这项工作中，我们引入了一个旨在模拟人类对图像渲染风格美学判断的新基准数据集：渲染美学评估数据集（DEAR）。DEAR建立在MIT-Adobe FiveK数据集之上，通过大规模众包纳入了成对的人类偏好评分，每对图像由25位不同的人类评估者进行评估，总共有13,648人参与。这些标注捕获了细致入微、依赖于上下文的美学偏好，从而能够开发和评估超越传统基于失真的IQA的模型，专注于一项新任务：渲染美学评估（EAR）。文中描述了数据收集流程，分析了人类的投票模式，并概述了多种使用案例，包括风格偏好预测、美学基准测试和个性化美学建模。据作者所知，DEAR是第一个系统地解决基于主观人类偏好的渲染图像美学评估的数据集。包含标记信息的100张图像子集已在HuggingFace上发布。
AI.summary: 本文针对传统IQA无法评估图像渲染美学主观性的问题，推出了DEAR（渲染美学评估数据集）。该数据集基于MIT-Adobe FiveK，通过大规模众包收集了成对的人类偏好评分，旨在为渲染美学评估（EAR）这一新任务提供基准。DEAR是首个系统化解决基于主观偏好的渲染美学评估的数据集，可用于风格偏好预测和个性化美学建模。
AI.keywords: 数据集, 渲染美学, 主观偏好, 图像质量评估, 众包
AI.comments: 创新点在于将图像评估的焦点从传统的客观技术质量（IQA）转移到主观的渲染美学偏好（EAR）。在大规模内容创作和AI生成图像时代，这种对主观风格偏好的建模至关重要。DEAR数据集通过大规模众包的成对偏好评分，为研究人员提供了一个急需的、稳健的基准，以开发更贴近人类审美的模型。其局限性可能在于其底层图像内容源于MIT-Adobe FiveK，但其核心价值在于对渲染风格的主观性评估。

title: State-Conditional Adversarial Learning: An Off-Policy Visual Domain Transfer Method for End-to-End Imitation Learning
summary: We study visual domain transfer for end-to-end imitation learning in a realistic and challenging setting where target-domain data are strictly off-policy, expert-free, and scarce. We first provide a theoretical analysis showing that the target-domain imitation loss can be upper bounded by the source-domain loss plus a state-conditional latent KL divergence between source and target observation models. Guided by this result, we propose State- Conditional Adversarial Learning, an off-policy adversarial framework that aligns latent distributions conditioned on system state using a discriminator-based estimator of the conditional KL term. Experiments on visually diverse autonomous driving environments built on the BARC-CARLA simulator demonstrate that SCAL achieves robust transfer and strong sample efficiency.

AI.title_translation: 状态条件对抗学习：一种用于端到端模仿学习的离策略视觉域迁移方法
AI.tldr: 我们提出了状态条件对抗学习（SCAL），这是一个由理论界限指导的离策略对抗框架，用于在目标数据有限且离策略的挑战性设置中，实现模仿学习的鲁棒视觉域迁移。
AI.motivation: 解决在目标域数据严格离策略、无专家且稀缺的现实挑战性设置中，端到端模仿学习的视觉域迁移问题。
AI.method: 首先进行理论分析，表明目标域模仿损失可以被源域损失加上源目标观测模型之间的状态条件潜在KL散度所界定。基于此，提出了状态条件对抗学习（SCAL）框架，该框架是一个离策略对抗框架，使用基于判别器的条件KL项估计器，对以系统状态为条件的潜在分布进行对齐。
AI.result: 在基于BARC-CARLA模拟器构建的视觉多样化自动驾驶环境中进行的实验表明，SCAL实现了鲁棒的迁移和强大的样本效率。
AI.conclusion: 状态条件对抗学习（SCAL）是一种在目标域数据稀缺且离策略的挑战性设置中，实现端到端模仿学习视觉域迁移的有效方法。
AI.translation: 我们研究在目标域数据严格离策略、无专家且稀缺的现实挑战性设置中，用于端到端模仿学习的视觉域迁移。我们首先提供了一个理论分析，表明目标域模仿损失可以被源域损失加上源和目标观测模型之间的状态条件潜在KL散度所界定。受此结果指导，我们提出了状态条件对抗学习（SCAL），这是一个离策略对抗框架，它使用基于判别器的条件KL项估计器，对以系统状态为条件的潜在分布进行对齐。在基于BARC-CARLA模拟器构建的视觉多样化自动驾驶环境中的实验表明，SCAL实现了鲁棒的迁移和强大的样本效率。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为状态条件对抗学习（SCAL）的离策略对抗框架，用于解决在目标域数据稀缺且离策略的挑战性设置中，端到端模仿学习的视觉域迁移问题。该方法首先通过理论分析得出目标损失的界限，该界限涉及一个状态条件潜在KL散度项。SCAL利用一个基于判别器的估计器来对齐以系统状态为条件的潜在分布。实验证明，SCAL在自动驾驶环境中实现了鲁棒的域迁移和高样本效率。
AI.keywords: 视觉域迁移, 模仿学习, 对抗学习, 离策略, 状态条件
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于将理论分析与实际的对抗性框架相结合，特别是在处理视觉域迁移的挑战性设置（离策略、无专家、数据稀缺）时。状态条件（State-Conditional）的引入是关键，因为它允许模型在对齐视觉特征时，利用系统状态信息进行更精细的控制，从而提高了迁移的鲁棒性和样本效率。这种方法对于现实世界中的机器人或自动驾驶应用具有重要意义，因为在这些场景中获取带标签的专家数据非常昂贵或困难。限制可能在于理论分析的假设是否完全适用于所有现实世界的复杂性，以及判别器估计条件KL散度的精确度。

title: Defining Cost Function of Steganography with Large Language Models
comments: Some minor typo errors are corrected, https://scholar.google.com/citations?hl=en&user=IdiF7M0AAAAJ
summary: In this paper, we make the first attempt towards defining cost function of steganography with large language models (LLMs), which is totally different from previous works that rely heavily on expert knowledge or require large-scale datasets for cost learning. To achieve this goal, a two-stage strategy combining LLM-guided program synthesis with evolutionary search is applied in the proposed method. In the first stage, a certain number of cost functions in the form of computer programs are synthesized from LLM responses to structured prompts. These cost functions are then evaluated with pretrained steganalysis models so that candidate cost functions suited to steganography can be collected. In the second stage, by retraining a steganalysis model for each candidate cost function, the optimal cost function(s) can be determined according to the detection accuracy. This two-stage strategy is performed by an iterative fashion so that the best cost function can be collected at the last iteration. Experiments show that the proposed method enables LLMs to design new cost functions of steganography that significantly outperform existing works in terms of resisting steganalysis tools, which verifies the superiority of the proposed method. To the best knowledge of the authors, this is the first work applying LLMs to the design of advanced cost function of steganography, which presents a novel perspective for steganography design and may shed light on further research.

AI.title_translation: 使用大型语言模型定义隐写术的成本函数
AI.tldr: 本文首次提出使用大型语言模型（LLMs）来定义隐写术的成本函数，采用两阶段（LLM程序合成 + 进化搜索）的迭代策略。实验证明，该方法设计的成本函数在抵抗现有隐写分析工具方面显著优于现有工作。
AI.motivation: 旨在利用大型语言模型（LLMs）定义隐写术的成本函数，以克服传统方法对专家知识或大规模数据集的重度依赖。
AI.method: 采用结合LLM引导的程序合成和进化搜索的两阶段迭代策略。第一阶段：LLM根据结构化提示合成作为计算机程序的成本函数，并使用预训练的隐写分析模型进行评估，收集候选成本函数。第二阶段：针对每个候选成本函数重新训练隐写分析模型，根据检测准确率确定最优成本函数。该过程迭代执行。
AI.result: 实验表明，所提出的方法使LLMs能够设计出在抵抗隐写分析工具方面显著优于现有工作的新的隐写术成本函数。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的方法成功地利用LLMs设计了先进的隐写术成本函数，验证了其优越性，并为隐写术设计提供了一个新颖的视角。
AI.translation: 在本文中，我们首次尝试使用大型语言模型（LLMs）来定义隐写术的成本函数，这与以往严重依赖专家知识或需要大规模数据集进行成本学习的工作完全不同。为实现这一目标，所提出的方法采用了结合LLM引导的程序合成与进化搜索的两阶段策略。在第一阶段，LLM根据结构化提示的响应合成一定数量的计算机程序形式的成本函数。然后，利用预训练的隐写分析模型对这些成本函数进行评估，从而收集适合隐写术的候选成本函数。在第二阶段，通过为每个候选成本函数重新训练一个隐写分析模型，可以根据检测准确率确定最优成本函数。该两阶段策略以迭代方式执行，从而在最后一次迭代中收集到最佳成本函数。实验表明，所提出的方法使LLMs能够设计出在抵抗隐写分析工具方面显著优于现有工作的新的隐写术成本函数，这验证了所提出方法的优越性。据作者所知，这是首次将LLMs应用于先进隐写术成本函数设计的工作，它为隐写术设计提供了一个新颖的视角，并可能为进一步的研究提供启发。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种利用大型语言模型（LLMs）定义隐写术成本函数的新方法，旨在避免对专家知识和大规模数据集的依赖。该方法采用两阶段迭代策略：首先，LLM通过程序合成生成成本函数候选，并用预训练的隐写分析模型进行筛选；其次，通过重新训练隐写分析模型并评估检测准确率来确定最优成本函数。实验结果显示，LLM设计的成本函数在抵抗隐写分析工具方面表现出显著优于现有工作的性能。
AI.keywords: 隐写术, 成本函数, 大型语言模型 (LLMs), 程序合成, 进化搜索
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于首次将大型语言模型（LLMs）引入到隐写术的核心设计要素——成本函数——的定义中。它摆脱了传统上依赖人工经验或大规模数据学习的局限性，通过结合LLM的程序合成能力和进化搜索的优化机制，实现了一种自动化、迭代的成本函数设计流程。这种方法不仅为隐写术设计提供了全新的视角，而且实验结果证明了LLM在抵抗隐写分析方面的优越性，预示着LLMs在安全和对抗性设计领域具有巨大的潜力。

title: Rethinking Popularity Bias in Collaborative Filtering via Analytical Vector Decomposition
summary: Popularity bias fundamentally undermines the personalization capabilities of collaborative filtering (CF) models, causing them to disproportionately recommend popular items while neglecting users' genuine preferences for niche content. While existing approaches treat this as an external confounding factor, we reveal that popularity bias is an intrinsic geometric artifact of Bayesian Pairwise Ranking (BPR) optimization in CF models. Through rigorous mathematical analysis, we prove that BPR systematically organizes item embeddings along a dominant "popularity direction" where embedding magnitudes directly correlate with interaction frequency. This geometric distortion forces user embeddings to simultaneously handle two conflicting tasks-expressing genuine preference and calibrating against global popularity-trapping them in suboptimal configurations that favor popular items regardless of individual tastes. We propose Directional Decomposition and Correction (DDC), a universally applicable framework that surgically corrects this embedding geometry through asymmetric directional updates. DDC guides positive interactions along personalized preference directions while steering negative interactions away from the global popularity direction, disentangling preference from popularity at the geometric source. Extensive experiments across multiple BPR-based architectures demonstrate that DDC significantly outperforms state-of-the-art debiasing methods, reducing training loss to less than 5% of heavily-tuned baselines while achieving superior recommendation quality and fairness. Code is available in https://github.com/LingFeng-Liu-AI/DDC.

AI.title_translation: 通过分析向量分解重新思考协同过滤中的流行度偏差
AI.tldr: 协作过滤（CF）中的流行度偏差是贝叶斯成对排序（BPR）优化固有的几何缺陷。本文提出方向分解与校正（DDC）框架，通过不对称的方向更新，在几何层面解耦偏好和流行度，显著提高了推荐质量和公平性。
AI.motivation: 流行度偏差严重损害了协同过滤（CF）模型的个性化能力，导致模型过度推荐热门项目而忽略用户对小众内容的真实偏好。现有的方法将其视为外部混杂因素，而本文旨在揭示其作为贝叶斯成对排序（BPR）优化中固有的几何产物。
AI.method: 首先，通过严格的数学分析证明BPR系统性地将项目嵌入组织在一个“流行度方向”上。然后，提出方向分解与校正（DDC）框架。DDC通过不对称的方向更新来修正嵌入的几何结构，引导正向交互沿着个性化偏好方向，同时将负向交互引导远离全局流行度方向，从而在几何源头上解耦偏好和流行度。
AI.result: DDC在多种基于BPR的架构上进行了广泛实验，结果表明它显著优于最先进的去偏方法，将训练损失降低到重度调优基线的不到5%，同时实现了卓越的推荐质量和公平性。
AI.translation: 流行度偏差从根本上破坏了协同过滤（CF）模型的个性化能力，导致它们不成比例地推荐热门项目，而忽略了用户对小众内容的真正偏好。虽然现有方法将其视为外部混杂因素，但我们揭示了流行度偏差是CF模型中贝叶斯成对排序（BPR）优化固有的几何产物。通过严格的数学分析，我们证明BPR系统性地沿着一个主导的“流行度方向”组织项目嵌入，其中嵌入的幅度直接与交互频率相关。这种几何畸变迫使用户嵌入同时处理两个相互冲突的任务——表达真实偏好和针对全局流行度进行校准——使它们陷入次优配置，无论个体品味如何都偏爱热门项目。我们提出了方向分解与校正（DDC），这是一个普遍适用的框架，它通过不对称的方向更新来对这种嵌入几何结构进行外科手术式的修正。DDC引导正向交互沿着个性化偏好方向，同时引导负向交互远离全局流行度方向，从而在几何源头上解耦偏好与流行度。跨多个基于BPR的架构进行的广泛实验证明，DDC显著优于最先进的去偏方法，将训练损失降低到经过大量调优的基线的不到5%，同时实现了卓越的推荐质量和公平性。
AI.summary: 本文重新审视了协同过滤中的流行度偏差问题，指出其是贝叶斯成对排序（BPR）优化固有的几何缺陷，表现为项目嵌入沿“流行度方向”组织。为解决这一问题，作者提出了方向分解与校正（DDC）框架。DDC通过不对称的方向更新，在几何层面上将用户的真实偏好与全局流行度解耦，通过引导正负样本更新方向的差异化来实现。实验证明，DDC显著优于现有去偏方法，并在推荐质量和公平性上均表现出色。
AI.keywords: 流行度偏差, 协同过滤, 贝叶斯成对排序, 向量分解, 几何校正
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于对流行度偏差的本质进行了深刻的理论分析，将其从外部因素重新定义为BPR优化过程中的内在“几何产物”。通过将问题定位在嵌入空间的几何畸变上，该方法（DDC）提供了一个优雅且具有普遍适用性的解决方案，通过不对称的方向性更新，直接在向量分解层面解耦了偏好和流行度。这种从理论洞察到实际算法设计的流程非常严谨，并且实验结果（训练损失降低至5%以下）显示出极高的效率和效果，对于提升基于BPR的推荐系统的个性化和公平性具有重要意义。

title: Hierarchical Dataset Selection for High-Quality Data Sharing
summary: The success of modern machine learning hinges on access to high-quality training data. In many real-world scenarios, such as acquiring data from public repositories or sharing across institutions, data is naturally organized into discrete datasets that vary in relevance, quality, and utility. Selecting which repositories or institutions to search for useful datasets, and which datasets to incorporate into model training are therefore critical decisions, yet most existing methods select individual samples and treat all data as equally relevant, ignoring differences between datasets and their sources. In this work, we formalize the task of dataset selection: selecting entire datasets from a large, heterogeneous pool to improve downstream performance under resource constraints. We propose Dataset Selection via Hierarchies (DaSH), a dataset selection method that models utility at both dataset and group (e.g., collections, institutions) levels, enabling efficient generalization from limited observations. Across two public benchmarks (Digit-Five and DomainNet), DaSH outperforms state-of-the-art data selection baselines by up to 26.2% in accuracy, while requiring significantly fewer exploration steps. Ablations show DaSH is robust to low-resource settings and lack of relevant datasets, making it suitable for scalable and adaptive dataset selection in practical multi-source learning workflows.

AI.title_translation: 高质量数据共享的分层数据集选择
AI.tldr: 针对现实世界中数据分散且质量不均的问题，本文提出了DaSH（分层数据集选择）方法。DaSH通过在数据集和数据集组两个层面上建模效用，实现了高效的数据集整体选择，在准确性上显著优于现有基线，且探索步骤更少。
AI.motivation: 现代机器学习的成功依赖于高质量的训练数据。在现实场景中，数据自然地组织成离散且相关性、质量和效用各异的数据集和数据组（如机构）。现有的数据选择方法通常只选择单个样本，忽略了数据集及其来源之间的差异。因此，该工作的动机是形式化并解决在资源约束下，从大型异构池中选择整个数据集以提高下游性能的任务。
AI.method: 提出了**Dataset Selection via Hierarchies (DaSH)**（通过层次结构进行数据集选择）方法。DaSH在数据集级别和组级别（例如，集合、机构）上对效用进行建模，从而能够从有限的观察中实现高效的泛化。
AI.result: 在两个公共基准（Digit-Five和DomainNet）上，DaSH的准确性比现有最先进的数据选择基线高出**26.2%**，同时所需的探索步骤显著减少。DaSH在低资源设置和缺乏相关数据集的情况下也表现出鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: DaSH是一种适用于实际多源学习工作流的可扩展和自适应的数据集选择方法，它通过分层建模，显著提高了数据选择效率和模型性能。
AI.translation: 现代机器学习的成功取决于能否获得高质量的训练数据。在许多现实世界的场景中，例如从公共存储库获取数据或跨机构共享数据，数据自然地组织成离散的数据集，这些数据集在相关性、质量和效用方面各不相同。因此，选择搜索哪些存储库或机构以找到有用的数据集，以及选择将哪些数据集纳入模型训练是至关重要的决策。然而，大多数现有方法选择单个样本，并将所有数据视为同样相关，忽略了数据集及其来源之间的差异。在这项工作中，我们形式化了数据集选择的任务：在资源约束下，从一个大型、异构的数据池中选择完整的数据集以提高下游性能。我们提出了通过层次结构进行数据集选择（DaSH）的方法，这是一种在数据集和组（例如，集合、机构）级别上建模效用的数据集选择方法，从而能够从有限的观察中实现高效的泛化。在两个公共基准（Digit-Five和DomainNet）上，DaSH的准确性比最先进的数据选择基线高出26.2%，同时所需的探索步骤显著减少。消融实验表明，DaSH对低资源设置和缺乏相关数据集的情况具有鲁棒性，使其适用于实际多源学习工作流中的可扩展和自适应的数据集选择。
AI.summary: 本文解决了在多源、异构环境中选择高质量训练数据的挑战。针对现有方法忽略数据集整体差异的问题，作者形式化了“数据集选择”任务，并提出了DaSH（分层数据集选择）方法。DaSH通过在数据集和更高层级的组（如机构）上建模数据效用，实现了高效的知识泛化和数据集整体选择。实验结果显示，DaSH在Digit-Five和DomainNet基准测试中显著优于现有基线，提高了26.2%的准确率，并减少了所需的探索步骤，证明了其在实际应用中的鲁棒性和可扩展性。
AI.keywords: 数据集选择, 分层建模, 数据共享, 多源学习, 数据质量
AI.comments: 该工作的创新点在于将数据选择的粒度从传统的单个样本提升到了**整个数据集和数据集组的层次**。通过引入层次结构建模（DaSH），该方法能够有效处理数据异构性和资源约束问题，这对于现实世界中涉及数据共享和多机构协作的机器学习流程具有重要意义。这种方法论上的转变，即从“样本选择”到“数据集选择”，是解决大规模、分布式数据质量问题的关键一步。

title: Redefining Information Theory: From Quantization and Rate--Distortion to a Foundational Mathematical Framework
comments: This is a preprint version. It has not been peer-reviewed
summary: This paper redefines information theory as a foundational mathematical discipline, extending beyond its traditional role in engineering applications. Building on Shannon's entropy, rate'--distortion theory, and Wyner'--Ziv coding, we show that all optimization methods can be interpreted as projections of continuous information onto discrete binary spaces. Numbers are not intrinsic carriers of meaning but codes of information, with binary digits (0 and 1) serving as universal symbols sufficient for all mathematical structures. Rate'--distortion optimization via Lagrangian multipliers connects quantization error directly to fundamental limits of representation, while Wyner'--Ziv coding admits a path integral interpretation over probability manifolds, unifying quantization, inference, geometry, and error. We further extend this framework into category theory, topological data analysis, and universal coding, situating computation and game theory as complementary perspectives. The result is a set of postulates that elevate information theory to the status of a universal mathematical language.

AI.title_translation: 重新定义信息论：从量化和率失真到基础数学框架
AI.tldr: 本文将信息论重新定义为基础数学框架，超越了工程应用。它基于香农熵、率失真和怀纳-齐夫编码，证明所有优化都可以解释为连续信息到二进制代码的投影，并形成一套统一量化、几何和误差的通用数学公设。
AI.motivation: 将信息论重新定义为一门基础数学学科，超越其在工程应用中的传统作用。
AI.method: 基于香农熵、率失真理论和怀纳-齐夫编码。将所有优化方法解释为连续信息到离散二进制空间的投影。通过拉格朗日乘子的率失真优化将量化误差与表示的基本限制直接联系起来。通过概率流形上的路径积分来解释怀纳-齐夫编码，并将其扩展到范畴论、拓扑数据分析和通用编码中。
AI.result: 表明二进制数字（0和1）是足以构建所有数学结构的通用符号。统一了量化、推理、几何和误差。形成了一套将信息论提升为通用数学语言的公设。
AI.conclusion: 通过一套公设，将信息论提升到通用数学语言的地位。
AI.translation: 本文将信息论重新定义为一门基础数学学科，超越了其在工程应用中的传统作用。基于香农熵、率失真理论和怀纳-齐夫编码，我们证明了所有优化方法都可以解释为连续信息到离散二进制空间的投影。数字并非内在含义的载体，而是信息的代码，其中二进制数字（0和1）是足以构建所有数学结构的通用符号。通过拉格朗日乘子的率失真优化将量化误差直接与表示的基本限制联系起来，而怀纳-齐夫编码则允许通过概率流形上的路径积分进行解释，从而统一了量化、推理、几何和误差。我们进一步将这一框架扩展到范畴论、拓扑数据分析和通用编码中，并将计算和博弈论视为互补的视角。其结果是一套将信息论提升为通用数学语言地位的公设。
AI.summary: 本文将信息论重新定义为一门基础数学学科，超越了其传统工程角色。它基于香农熵、率失真理论和怀纳-齐夫编码，核心观点是所有优化方法都可以解释为连续信息到离散二进制空间的投影，其中二进制数字是构建所有数学结构的通用符号。该框架通过率失真中的拉格朗日乘子将量化误差与表示的基本限制联系起来，并通过路径积分解释怀纳-齐夫编码，从而统一了量化、推理、几何和误差。这一扩展框架纳入了范畴论和拓扑数据分析等，最终形成了一套将信息论提升为通用数学语言的公设。
AI.keywords: 信息论, 基础框架, 量化, 率失真, 通用符号
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于其宏大的目标：将信息论从工程工具提升为基础数学学科，类似于集合论或逻辑学。它明确地将优化、量化、怀纳-齐夫编码、路径积分与抽象数学领域（范畴论、拓扑数据分析）联系起来，旨在实现深刻的理论统一。如果成功，其重要性将是深远的，为数学和计算提供了一种新的通用语言。局限性在于摘要仅提供了高度概念性的愿景，没有详细说明具体的数学证明或最终公设的确切内容。

title: On the Design of One-step Diffusion via Shortcutting Flow Paths
comments: 10 pages of main body, conference paper
summary: Recent advances in few-step diffusion models have demonstrated their efficiency and effectiveness by shortcutting the probabilistic paths of diffusion models, especially in training one-step diffusion models from scratch (\emph{a.k.a.} shortcut models). However, their theoretical derivation and practical implementation are often closely coupled, which obscures the design space. To address this, we propose a common design framework for representative shortcut models. This framework provides theoretical justification for their validity and disentangles concrete component-level choices, thereby enabling systematic identification of improvements. With our proposed improvements, the resulting one-step model achieves a new state-of-the-art FID50k of 2.85 on ImageNet-256x256 under the classifier-free guidance setting with one step generation, and further reaches FID50k of 2.53 with 2x training steps. Remarkably, the model requires no pre-training, distillation, or curriculum learning. We believe our work lowers the barrier to component-level innovation in shortcut models and facilitates principled exploration of their design space.

AI.title_translation: 关于通过捷径流路径设计一步扩散模型
AI.tldr: 本文为一步扩散模型（捷径模型）提出了一个通用设计框架，解耦了理论与实践设计，从而实现了无需预训练或蒸馏的SOTA性能（ImageNet上FID 2.85/2.53）。
AI.motivation: 现有的一步扩散模型（即捷径模型）的理论推导和实际实现紧密耦合，模糊了设计空间。本文旨在提出一个通用设计框架来解决此问题，并系统地识别改进点。
AI.method: 提出了一个针对代表性捷径模型的通用设计框架。该框架为模型的有效性提供了理论依据，并解耦了具体的组件级选择。在此基础上，提出了改进措施。
AI.result: 改进后的一步模型在ImageNet-256x256上，单步生成并在无分类器指导设置下，实现了新的SOTA FID50k 2.85；训练步骤加倍后达到FID50k 2.53。该模型无需预训练、蒸馏或课程学习。
AI.conclusion: 本工作降低了捷径模型中组件级创新的门槛，并促进了对其设计空间的有原则探索。
AI.translation: 近期在少步扩散模型方面的进展通过对扩散模型的概率路径进行捷径处理，展示了其效率和有效性，尤其是在从头开始训练一步扩散模型（亦称捷径模型）方面。然而，它们的理论推导和实际实现往往紧密耦合，模糊了设计空间。为了解决这个问题，我们为代表性的捷径模型提出了一个通用设计框架。该框架为其有效性提供了理论依据，并解耦了具体的组件级选择，从而能够系统地识别改进点。凭借我们提出的改进措施，所得到的一步模型在ImageNet-256x256上，在无分类器指导设置下，通过一步生成实现了新的最先进的FID50k 2.85，并且在2倍训练步骤下进一步达到了FID50k 2.53。值得注意的是，该模型不需要预训练、蒸馏或课程学习。我们相信我们的工作降低了捷径模型中组件级创新的门槛，并促进了对其设计空间的有原则探索。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一个通用设计框架，旨在统一和厘清一步扩散模型（捷径模型）的设计空间。通过解耦组件级选择并提供理论依据，该框架促进了系统的改进。由此产生的模型在ImageNet-256x256上单步生成实现了新的最先进的FID50k 2.85，证明了这种有原则设计方法的有效性。
AI.keywords: 扩散模型, 一步生成, 捷径流路径, 设计框架, FID50k
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于提出了一个通用框架，将捷径模型（一步扩散模型）的理论推导与实际实现相解耦，从而实现了系统性的组件级优化。其重要性体现在无需依赖蒸馏或预训练等常见技术，即可在ImageNet上实现SOTA结果（FID 2.85），这表明其对模型架构或训练过程本身带来了根本性的改进。这项工作成功地降低了未来高效扩散模型设计研究的门槛。

title: Compressed Causal Reasoning: Quantization and GraphRAG Effects on Interventional and Counterfactual Accuracy
summary: Causal reasoning in Large Language Models spanning association, intervention, and counterfactual inference is essential for reliable decision making in high stakes settings. As deployment shifts toward edge and resource constrained environments, quantized models such as INT8 and NF4 are becoming standard. Yet the impact of precision reduction on formal causal reasoning is poorly understood. To our knowledge, this is the first study to systematically evaluate quantization effects across all three levels of Pearls Causal Ladder. Using a 3000 sample stratified CLadder benchmark, we find that rung level accuracy in Llama 3 8B remains broadly stable under quantization, with NF4 showing less than one percent overall degradation. Interventional queries at rung 2 are the most sensitive to precision loss, whereas counterfactual reasoning at rung 3 is comparatively stable but exhibits heterogeneous weaknesses across query types such as collider bias and backdoor adjustment. Experiments on the CRASS benchmark show near identical performance across precisions, indicating that existing commonsense counterfactual datasets lack the structural sensitivity needed to reveal quantization induced reasoning drift. We further evaluate Graph Retrieval Augmented Generation using ground truth causal graphs and observe a consistent improvement in NF4 interventional accuracy of plus 1.7 percent, partially offsetting compression related degradation. These results suggest that causal reasoning is unexpectedly robust to four bit quantization, graph structured augmentation can selectively reinforce interventional reasoning, and current counterfactual benchmarks fail to capture deeper causal brittleness. This work provides an initial empirical map of compressed causal reasoning and practical guidance for deploying efficient and structurally supported causal AI systems.

AI.title_translation: 压缩因果推理：量化和GraphRAG对干预和反事实准确性的影响
AI.tldr: 量化（INT8/NF4）对大型语言模型的因果推理（包括关联、干预和反事实）影响很小，NF4尤其稳定。干预推理对精度损失最敏感，但GraphRAG可以提高其准确性。
AI.motivation: 因果推理对高风险决策至关重要。随着部署转向资源受限环境，量化模型成为标准，但量化对形式因果推理的影响尚不清楚，因此需要系统评估。
AI.method: 使用3000个样本的分层CLadder基准，系统评估了Llama 3 8B模型在INT8和NF4量化下对Pearl因果阶梯三个层级（关联、干预、反事实）的影响。在CRASS基准上进行了测试，并评估了使用真实因果图的GraphRAG效果。
AI.result: Llama 3 8B在量化下（特别是NF4）层级准确性大致稳定（总体降级不到1%）。干预查询（第2层）对精度损失最敏感。GraphRAG持续提高了NF4干预准确性1.7%。现有反事实基准（如CRASS）缺乏揭示量化诱导推理漂移所需的结构敏感性。
AI.conclusion: 因果推理对四位量化表现出意外的鲁棒性。图结构增强可以选择性地强化干预推理。现有反事实基准未能捕获更深层次的因果脆弱性。这项工作为部署高效且结构化支持的因果AI系统提供了实用指导。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型中的因果推理，包括关联、干预和反事实推理，对于高风险环境中的可靠决策至关重要。随着部署转向边缘和资源受限环境，INT8和NF4等量化模型正成为标准。然而，精度降低对形式因果推理的影响却知之甚少。据我们所知，这是首次系统地评估量化对Pearl因果阶梯所有三个层级影响的研究。我们使用一个包含3000个样本的分层CLadder基准测试发现，Llama 3 8B模型的层级准确性在量化下大致保持稳定，其中NF4的总体降级不到1%。第2层级的干预查询对精度损失最为敏感，而第3层级的反事实推理相对稳定，但在某些查询类型（如对撞机偏差和后门调整）上表现出异构的弱点。在CRASS基准上的实验显示，不同精度下的性能几乎相同，这表明现有常识反事实数据集缺乏揭示量化引起的推理漂移所需的结构敏感性。我们进一步评估了使用真实因果图的图检索增强生成（GraphRAG），并观察到NF4干预准确性持续提高了1.7%，部分抵消了压缩相关的性能下降。这些结果表明，因果推理对四位量化具有出乎意料的鲁棒性，图结构增强可以选择性地强化干预推理，并且当前的反事实基准未能捕获更深层次的因果脆弱性。这项工作为压缩因果推理提供了一个初步的经验图谱，并为部署高效且结构化支持的因果AI系统提供了实用指导。
AI.summary: 本研究系统评估了模型量化（INT8, NF4）对Llama 3 8B模型因果推理（Pearl因果阶梯三层）准确性的影响。结果显示，因果推理对四位量化具有意外的鲁棒性，其中干预查询最敏感。图检索增强生成（GraphRAG）能有效提升量化模型的干预准确性（+1.7%）。研究还指出，现有反事实基准的结构敏感性不足以揭示量化导致的推理漂移。
AI.keywords: 压缩因果推理, 量化, GraphRAG, Pearl因果阶梯, 大型语言模型
AI.comments: 本研究首次系统性地评估了量化对Pearl因果阶梯所有三个层级的影响，具有重要的开创性。其重要性在于为在资源受限环境中部署高效且可靠的因果LLM提供了实用的经验指导。发现因果推理对四位量化具有鲁棒性是出乎意料的积极结果。局限性在于干预推理仍然是精度损失最敏感的部分，且现有反事实基准的挑战性不足。

title: Safe Online Control-Informed Learning
summary: This paper proposes a Safe Online Control-Informed Learning framework for safety-critical autonomous systems. The framework unifies optimal control, parameter estimation, and safety constraints into an online learning process. It employs an extended Kalman filter to incrementally update system parameters in real time, enabling robust and data-efficient adaptation under uncertainty. A softplus barrier function enforces constraint satisfaction during learning and control while eliminating the dependence on high-quality initial guesses. Theoretical analysis establishes convergence and safety guarantees, and the framework's effectiveness is demonstrated on cart-pole and robot-arm systems.

AI.title_translation: 安全在线控制信息学习
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个用于安全关键系统的安全在线学习框架，它结合了最优控制和扩展卡尔曼滤波，并使用软加障碍函数来实时确保约束满足，实现高效且安全的参数适应。
AI.motivation: 针对安全关键的自主系统，提出一个统一的在线学习框架，旨在不确定性下实现鲁棒且数据高效的适应性控制，并确保安全。
AI.method: 提出了一个安全在线控制信息学习框架，将最优控制、参数估计和安全约束统一到在线学习过程中。使用扩展卡尔曼滤波实时增量更新系统参数，并通过软加障碍函数（softplus barrier function）来强制满足约束，同时消除对高质量初始猜测的依赖。
AI.result: 理论分析确立了收敛性和安全性保证。在倒立摆和机械臂系统上验证了框架的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该安全在线控制信息学习框架成功地将控制、估计和安全约束集成到一个在线过程中，实现了在不确定性下的安全、鲁棒和数据高效的适应性控制。
AI.translation: 本文提出了一种用于安全关键自主系统的安全在线控制信息学习框架。该框架将最优控制、参数估计和安全约束统一到一个在线学习过程中。它采用扩展卡尔曼滤波实时增量更新系统参数，从而在不确定性下实现鲁棒且数据高效的适应性。此外，软加障碍函数在学习和控制过程中强制满足约束，同时消除了对高质量初始猜测的依赖。理论分析确立了收敛性和安全性保证，并在倒立摆和机械臂系统上证明了该框架的有效性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种用于安全关键自主系统的安全在线控制信息学习框架。该框架将最优控制、扩展卡尔曼滤波（用于实时增量参数更新）和安全约束（通过软加障碍函数强制执行）统一起来。该方法具有理论上的收敛性和安全性保证，并通过消除对高质量初始猜测的依赖来提高鲁棒性。其有效性已在倒立摆和机械臂系统上得到验证。
AI.keywords: 安全在线学习, 扩展卡尔曼滤波, 软加障碍函数, 安全关键系统
AI.comments: 该研究的创新点在于提出了一个统一的在线学习框架，将最优控制、基于扩展卡尔曼滤波的实时参数估计与安全约束（通过软加障碍函数实现）高效集成。软加障碍函数的使用尤其重要，因为它解决了传统安全控制方法对高质量初始参数猜测的依赖问题，显著提高了系统在实际应用中的鲁棒性和实用性。

title: VLegal-Bench: Cognitively Grounded Benchmark for Vietnamese Legal Reasoning of Large Language Models
summary: The rapid advancement of large language models (LLMs) has enabled new possibilities for applying artificial intelligence within the legal domain. Nonetheless, the complexity, hierarchical organization, and frequent revisions of Vietnamese legislation pose considerable challenges for evaluating how well these models interpret and utilize legal knowledge. To address this gap, the Vietnamese Legal Benchmark (VLegal-Bench) is introduced, the first comprehensive benchmark designed to systematically assess LLMs on Vietnamese legal tasks. Informed by Bloom's cognitive taxonomy, VLegal-Bench encompasses multiple levels of legal understanding through tasks designed to reflect practical usage scenarios. The benchmark comprises 10,450 samples generated through a rigorous annotation pipeline, where legal experts label and cross-validate each instance using our annotation system to ensure every sample is grounded in authoritative legal documents and mirrors real-world legal assistant workflows, including general legal questions and answers, retrieval-augmented generation, multi-step reasoning, and scenario-based problem solving tailored to Vietnamese law. By providing a standardized, transparent, and cognitively informed evaluation framework, VLegal-Bench establishes a solid foundation for assessing LLM performance in Vietnamese legal contexts and supports the development of more reliable, interpretable, and ethically aligned AI-assisted legal systems. To facilitate access and reproducibility, we provide a public landing page for this benchmark at https://vilegalbench.cmcai.vn/.

AI.title_translation: VLegal-Bench：基于认知基础的大型语言模型越南法律推理基准
AI.tldr: 针对越南法律的复杂性，本文推出了首个综合性、基于布鲁姆认知分类学的越南法律推理基准VLegal-Bench，包含10,450个经过法律专家严格标注的样本，用于评估和提升LLM在越南法律任务中的表现。
AI.motivation: 尽管LLM在法律领域应用潜力巨大，但越南立法的复杂性、层级结构和频繁修订给评估模型解释和利用法律知识的能力带来了巨大挑战。因此，需要一个系统性的评估工具来解决这一差距。
AI.method: 引入了VLegal-Bench，这是首个全面评估越南法律任务的基准。该基准基于布鲁姆认知分类法，包含10,450个样本，通过严格的标注流程生成，由法律专家使用标注系统进行标记和交叉验证。任务设计反映了现实世界的法律助理工作流程，包括通用法律问答、检索增强生成（RAG）、多步骤推理和基于场景的问题解决。
AI.conclusion: VLegal-Bench通过提供一个标准化、透明且认知知情的评估框架，为评估LLM在越南法律背景下的性能奠定了坚实的基础，并支持开发更可靠、可解释且符合道德规范的AI辅助法律系统。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）的快速发展为人工智能在法律领域的应用带来了新的可能性。尽管如此，越南立法的复杂性、层级组织和频繁修订给评估这些模型解释和利用法律知识的程度带来了相当大的挑战。为了弥补这一差距，本文介绍了越南法律基准（VLegal-Bench），这是第一个旨在系统评估LLMs在越南法律任务中表现的综合基准。VLegal-Bench以布鲁姆认知分类法为指导，通过旨在反映实际使用场景的任务，涵盖了多个层次的法律理解。该基准包含10,450个样本，这些样本是通过严格的标注流程生成的，法律专家使用我们的标注系统对每个实例进行标记和交叉验证，以确保每个样本都以权威法律文件为基础，并反映真实世界的法律助理工作流程，包括通用法律问答、检索增强生成、多步骤推理和针对越南法律量身定制的基于场景的问题解决。通过提供一个标准化、透明且认知知情的评估框架，VLegal-Bench为评估LLM在越南法律背景下的性能奠定了坚实的基础，并支持开发更可靠、可解释且符合道德规范的AI辅助法律系统。为了方便访问和重现性，我们为该基准提供了一个公共登录页面：https://vilegalbench.cmcai.vn/。
AI.summary: 本文推出了VLegal-Bench，这是首个全面评估大型语言模型（LLM）在越南法律推理任务中表现的基准。鉴于越南法律的复杂性，VLegal-Bench基于布鲁姆认知分类法设计，旨在覆盖多层次的法律理解。它包含10,450个经过法律专家严格标注和交叉验证的样本，任务类型涵盖通用问答、RAG、多步骤推理和场景求解，以模拟真实法律工作流程。该基准提供了一个标准化的评估框架，旨在促进开发更可靠、可解释的越南AI法律系统。
AI.keywords: 越南法律推理, 大型语言模型, 基准, 认知分类法, 法律助理工作流
AI.comments: VLegal-Bench的创新性在于它是第一个专门针对越南法律任务的综合性基准，填补了这一特定语言和法律体系的空白。其重要性在于，它采用了“认知分类学”（如布鲁姆分类法）来设计任务，确保评估不仅停留在事实检索层面，还能测试LLM的多级法律理解和推理能力，这对于开发高可靠性的AI法律助理至关重要。严格的专家标注和对权威法律文件的依赖保证了数据的质量和实用性。

title: Universal Reasoning Model
summary: Universal transformers (UTs) have been widely used for complex reasoning tasks such as ARC-AGI and Sudoku, yet the specific sources of their performance gains remain underexplored. In this work, we systematically analyze UTs variants and show that improvements on ARC-AGI primarily arise from the recurrent inductive bias and strong nonlinear components of Transformer, rather than from elaborate architectural designs. Motivated by this finding, we propose the Universal Reasoning Model (URM), which enhances the UT with short convolution and truncated backpropagation. Our approach substantially improves reasoning performance, achieving state-of-the-art 53.8% pass@1 on ARC-AGI 1 and 16.0% pass@1 on ARC-AGI 2. Our code is avaliable at https://github.com/UbiquantAI/URM.

AI.tldr: 通过分析发现通用Transformer的性能提升主要来自循环归纳偏置和非线性组件。基于此，本文提出了通用推理模型（URM），通过引入短卷积和截断反向传播，在ARC-AGI基准测试上实现了SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 尽管通用Transformer（UTs）已被广泛用于ARC-AGI等复杂推理任务，但其性能增益的具体来源仍未得到充分探索。
AI.method: 首先，系统分析了通用Transformer（UTs）变体，发现其性能提升主要源于循环归纳偏置和强大的非线性组件。然后，基于此发现，提出了通用推理模型（URM），通过短卷积和截断反向传播来增强UT。
AI.result: URM显著提高了推理性能，在ARC-AGI 1上实现了53.8% pass@1，在ARC-AGI 2上实现了16.0% pass@1，达到了当前最佳（SOTA）水平。
AI.translation: 通用Transformer（UTs）已被广泛用于ARC-AGI和数独等复杂推理任务，但其性能增益的具体来源仍未得到充分探索。在这项工作中，我们系统地分析了UTs变体，并表明在ARC-AGI上的改进主要源于Transformer的循环归纳偏置和强大的非线性组件，而不是源于精心设计的架构。受这一发现的启发，我们提出了通用推理模型（URM），它通过短卷积和截断反向传播来增强UT。我们的方法实质性地提高了推理性能，在ARC-AGI 1上实现了当前最佳的53.8% pass@1，在ARC-AGI 2上实现了16.0% pass@1。我们的代码可在https://github.com/UbiquantAI/URM获取。
AI.summary: 本文对通用Transformer（UTs）在复杂推理任务（如ARC-AGI）中的性能来源进行了系统分析，发现其主要优势来自循环归纳偏置和非线性组件。基于此，研究人员提出了通用推理模型（URM），通过结合短卷积和截断反向传播来增强UT。URM显著提升了推理表现，在ARC-AGI基准测试上取得了最新的SOTA结果。
AI.keywords: 通用推理模型, Universal Transformer, ARC-AGI, 循环归纳偏置, 截断反向传播
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于并非简单地提出新的复杂架构，而是首先通过系统分析确定了通用Transformer性能的关键驱动因素（循环归纳偏置和非线性），这为后续的模型设计提供了坚实的理论基础和明确的方向。所提出的URM模型通过结合短卷积和截断反向传播来优化这些关键组件，以最小的架构改动实现了显著的性能提升，尤其是在ARC-AGI这一复杂的通用推理基准上达到了SOTA，显示出其方法的有效性和重要性。

title: T5Gemma 2: Seeing, Reading, and Understanding Longer
summary: We introduce T5Gemma 2, the next generation of the T5Gemma family of lightweight open encoder-decoder models, featuring strong multilingual, multimodal and long-context capabilities. T5Gemma 2 follows the adaptation recipe (via UL2) in T5Gemma -- adapting a pretrained decoder-only model into an encoder-decoder model, and extends it from text-only regime to multimodal based on the Gemma 3 models. We further propose two methods to improve the efficiency: tied word embedding that shares all embeddings across encoder and decoder, and merged attention that unifies decoder self- and cross-attention into a single joint module. Experiments demonstrate the generality of the adaptation strategy over architectures and modalities as well as the unique strength of the encoder-decoder architecture on long context modeling. Similar to T5Gemma, T5Gemma 2 yields comparable or better pretraining performance and significantly improved post-training performance than its Gemma 3 counterpart. We release the pretrained models (270M-270M, 1B-1B and 4B-4B) to the community for future research.

AI.title_translation: T5Gemma 2：看得更广、读得更深、理解更长
AI.tldr: T5Gemma 2是T5Gemma系列的下一代轻量级开放编码器-解码器模型，通过UL2方法将Gemma 3解码器模型适配为多模态模型，并引入了共享词嵌入和合并注意力机制来提高效率，在长上下文和后训练性能上表现出色。
AI.motivation: 开发下一代轻量级开放编码器-解码器模型T5Gemma 2，旨在提供强大的多语言、多模态和长上下文处理能力。
AI.method: 沿用T5Gemma的适配方案（通过UL2），将预训练的纯解码器模型（基于Gemma 3）适配成多模态编码器-解码器模型。为提高效率，提出了两种方法：1. 共享编码器和解码器所有嵌入的“共享词嵌入”（tied word embedding）。2. 将解码器自注意力和交叉注意力统一为一个联合模块的“合并注意力”（merged attention）。
AI.result: 实验证明了该适配策略在不同架构和模态上的通用性。编码器-解码器架构在长上下文建模上表现出独特优势。T5Gemma 2的预训练性能与Gemma 3对应模型相当或更优，且后训练性能显著提高。已发布270M-270M、1B-1B和4B-4B预训练模型。
AI.conclusion: T5Gemma 2成功地将Gemma 3纯解码器模型通过UL2适配和结构优化（如共享词嵌入和合并注意力）转化为下一代轻量级、开放的多语言、多模态编码器-解码器模型。该模型在长上下文建模上展示了编码器-解码器架构的独特优势，并在预训练性能相当或更优的情况下，显著提高了后训练性能。预训练模型已向社区开放。
AI.translation: 我们引入了T5Gemma 2，这是T5Gemma系列轻量级开放编码器-解码器模型的下一代，具有强大的多语言、多模态和长上下文处理能力。T5Gemma 2沿用了T5Gemma中的适配方案（通过UL2）——将预训练的纯解码器模型适配成编码器-解码器模型，并基于Gemma 3模型将其从纯文本范畴扩展到多模态。我们进一步提出了两种提高效率的方法：共享编码器和解码器所有嵌入的共享词嵌入（tied word embedding），以及将解码器自注意力和交叉注意力统一为一个联合模块的合并注意力（merged attention）。实验证明了该适配策略在不同架构和模态上的通用性，以及编码器-解码器架构在长上下文建模上的独特优势。与T5Gemma类似，T5Gemma 2的预训练性能与Gemma 3对应模型相当或更优，且后训练性能显著提高。我们向社区发布了预训练模型（270M-270M、1B-1B和4B-4B），以供未来研究。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了T5Gemma 2，一种轻量级、开放的多语言、多模态编码器-解码器模型，它是通过UL2方法将Gemma 3纯解码器模型适配而来，并扩展了多模态能力。为提升效率，模型采用了共享词嵌入和合并注意力机制。实验结果证实了该适配策略的通用性以及编码器-解码器架构在长上下文建模上的优势，T5Gemma 2在后训练性能上显著优于其Gemma 3对应模型。
AI.keywords: T5Gemma 2, 编码器-解码器, 多模态, 长上下文, 共享词嵌入
AI.comments:
**创新性：** 本文的核心创新在于将预训练的纯解码器模型（Gemma 3）通过UL2适配方法成功且高效地转化为具备多模态和长上下文处理能力的编码器-解码器模型T5Gemma 2。此外，提出的共享词嵌入和合并注意力机制是提升模型效率的关键技术，特别是合并注意力机制，它通过统一解码器的自注意力和交叉注意力，简化了模型结构并可能提高了推理速度。

**重要性：** T5Gemma 2的发布（作为开放模型）为研究社区提供了一个强大的、轻量级的多语言、多模态基线模型。它证明了编码器-解码器架构在长上下文建模和后训练性能优化方面相比纯解码器架构的独特优势，这对于需要强大理解和生成能力的任务至关重要。

**局限性（基于摘要）：** 摘要中虽然提到了“Seeing, Reading, and Understanding”，但缺乏关于多模态能力的具体实现细节（例如视觉编码器或模态对齐机制）以及其在特定多模态基准测试上的量化性能。

title: Intersectional Fairness in Vision-Language Models for Medical Image Disease Classification
summary: Medical artificial intelligence (AI) systems, particularly multimodal vision-language models (VLM), often exhibit intersectional biases where models are systematically less confident in diagnosing marginalised patient subgroups. Such bias can lead to higher rates of inaccurate and missed diagnoses due to demographically skewed data and divergent distributions of diagnostic certainty. Current fairness interventions frequently fail to address these gaps or compromise overall diagnostic performance to achieve statistical parity among the subgroups. In this study, we developed Cross-Modal Alignment Consistency (CMAC-MMD), a training framework that standardises diagnostic certainty across intersectional patient subgroups. Unlike traditional debiasing methods, this approach equalises the model's decision confidence without requiring sensitive demographic data during clinical inference. We evaluated this approach using 10,015 skin lesion images (HAM10000) with external validation on 12,000 images (BCN20000), and 10,000 fundus images for glaucoma detection (Harvard-FairVLMed), stratifying performance by intersectional age, gender, and race attributes. In the dermatology cohort, the proposed method reduced the overall intersectional missed diagnosis gap (difference in True Positive Rate, $Δ$TPR) from 0.50 to 0.26 while improving the overall Area Under the Curve (AUC) from 0.94 to 0.97 compared to standard training. Similarly, for glaucoma screening, the method reduced $Δ$TPR from 0.41 to 0.31, achieving a better AUC of 0.72 (vs. 0.71 baseline). This establishes a scalable framework for developing high-stakes clinical decision support systems that are both accurate and can perform equitably across diverse patient subgroups, ensuring reliable performance without increasing privacy risks.

AI.title_translation: 医影像疾病分类中的视觉-语言模型的交叉公平性
AI.tldr: 医疗视觉-语言模型存在交叉偏见。我们提出了CMAC-MMD训练框架，它能标准化不同交叉子群体的诊断确定性，在皮肤病学和青光眼检测数据集上显著缩小了漏诊差距（ΔTPR）并提高了AUC，且在推理时无需敏感的人口统计数据。
AI.motivation: 医疗AI系统（特别是视觉-语言模型VLM）对边缘化患者亚群表现出交叉偏见，导致诊断信心不足，错诊和漏诊率更高。现有的公平性干预措施往往无法解决这些问题或以牺牲整体诊断性能为代价。因此，需要开发一种既能解决交叉偏见又不影响整体准确性，且在临床推理时无需敏感人口数据的公平性框架。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为“跨模态对齐一致性”（Cross-Modal Alignment Consistency, CMAC-MMD）的训练框架。该方法通过均衡模型的决策信心，实现了跨交叉患者亚群的诊断确定性标准化。关键在于，它在临床推理时不需要敏感的人口统计数据。
AI.result: 在皮肤病学队列中，提出的方法将总体交叉漏诊差距（ΔTPR）从0.50降低到0.26，同时将总体曲线下面积（AUC）从0.94提高到0.97。在青光眼筛查中，该方法将ΔTPR从0.41降低到0.31，实现了更好的AUC（0.72，基线为0.71）。
AI.conclusion: CMAC-MMD建立了一个可扩展的框架，用于开发高风险的临床决策支持系统，该系统既准确又能在不同的患者亚群中公平地执行任务，确保可靠的性能，同时不增加隐私风险。
AI.translation: 医疗人工智能（AI）系统，特别是多模态视觉-语言模型（VLM），经常表现出交叉偏见，即模型在诊断边缘化患者亚群时系统性地缺乏信心。这种偏见可能导致不准确和漏诊率的提高，原因在于人口统计学上倾斜的数据和诊断确定性的分布差异。目前的公平性干预措施往往无法弥补这些差距，或者为了在亚群之间实现统计学上的平等而牺牲了整体诊断性能。在本研究中，我们开发了跨模态对齐一致性（Cross-Modal Alignment Consistency, CMAC-MMD），这是一个训练框架，用于标准化跨交叉患者亚群的诊断确定性。与传统的去偏方法不同，该方法均衡了模型的决策信心，同时在临床推理时不需要敏感的人口统计数据。我们使用10,015张皮肤病变图像（HAM10000）进行了评估，并在12,000张图像（BCN20000）上进行了外部验证，以及使用10,000张眼底图像进行青光眼检测（Harvard-FairVLMed），按交叉的年龄、性别和种族属性对性能进行了分层。在皮肤病学队列中，与标准训练相比，所提出的方法将总体交叉漏诊差距（真阳性率差异，$Δ$TPR）从0.50降低到0.26，同时将总体曲线下面积（AUC）从0.94提高到0.97。类似地，对于青光眼筛查，该方法将$Δ$TPR从0.41降低到0.31，并实现了更好的AUC（0.72，基线为0.71）。这建立了一个可扩展的框架，用于开发高风险的临床决策支持系统，该系统既准确又能在不同的患者亚群中公平地执行任务，确保可靠的性能，同时不增加隐私风险。
AI.summary: 本文解决了医疗视觉-语言模型（VLM）中的交叉偏见问题，即边缘化亚群的诊断信心较低。作者引入了跨模态对齐一致性（CMAC-MMD），这是一种旨在标准化跨交叉子群体的诊断确定性的新型训练框架。与传统去偏方法不同，CMAC-MMD在临床推理时无需敏感的人口统计数据即可均衡决策信心。实验表明，CMAC-MMD显著缩小了交叉漏诊差距（ΔTPR），同时提高了总体曲线下面积（AUC），为开发准确且公平的临床AI系统奠定了基础。
AI.keywords: 交叉公平性, 视觉-语言模型, 医学图像分类, CMAC-MMD, 诊断确定性
AI.comments: 创新点在于解决了交叉公平性问题（与单一属性公平性相比，这常被忽视），并将其应用于关键的医疗AI领域。该方法（CMAC-MMD）的突出之处在于，它在提高公平性（减少ΔTPR，即漏诊差距）的同时，并没有牺牲整体准确性（提高了AUC），并且最重要的是，通过在推理时无需敏感的人口统计数据来维护隐私。这使得该框架对于现实世界的临床部署具有高度实用性。

title: DiffusionVL: Translating Any Autoregressive Models into Diffusion Vision Language Models
comments: 11 pages, 5 figures, conference or other essential info
summary: In recent multimodal research, the diffusion paradigm has emerged as a promising alternative to the autoregressive paradigm (AR), owing to its unique decoding advantages. However, due to the capability limitations of the base diffusion language model, the performance of the diffusion vision language model (dVLM) still lags significantly behind that of mainstream models. This leads to a simple yet fundamental question: Is it possible to construct dVLMs based on existing powerful AR models? In response, we propose DiffusionVL, a dVLM family that could be translated from any powerful AR models. Through simple fine-tuning, we successfully adapt AR pre-trained models into the diffusion paradigm. This approach yields two key observations: (1) The paradigm shift from AR-based multimodal models to diffusion is remarkably effective. (2) Direct conversion of an AR language model to a dVLM is also feasible, achieving performance competitive with LLaVA-style visual-instruction-tuning. Further, we introduce a block-decoding design into dVLMs that supports arbitrary-length generation and KV cache reuse, achieving a significant inference speedup. We conduct a large number of experiments. Despite training with less than 5% of the data required by prior methods, DiffusionVL achieves a comprehensive performance improvement-a 34.4% gain on the MMMU-Pro (vision) bench and 37.5% gain on the MME (Cog.) bench-alongside a 2x inference speedup. The model and code are released at https://github.com/hustvl/DiffusionVL.
comment: 11 pages, 5 figures, conference or other essential info

AI.title_translation: DiffusionVL：将任意自回归模型转化为扩散视觉语言模型
AI.tldr: 研究者提出了DiffusionVL，一种通过简单微调将现有强大自回归（AR）模型转换为扩散视觉语言模型（dVLM）的方法。它在大幅减少训练数据（少于5%）的情况下，实现了显著的性能提升（MMMU-Pro和MME基准测试分别提高34.4%和37.5%），并通过块解码设计实现了2倍的推理加速。
AI.motivation: 尽管扩散范式（Diffusion Paradigm）在多模态研究中展现出独特的解码优势，但现有扩散视觉语言模型（dVLM）的性能受限于其基础扩散语言模型的性能，显著落后于主流模型。因此，研究的动机是探索是否能基于现有强大的自回归（AR）模型来构建高性能的dVLM。
AI.method: 提出了DiffusionVL模型家族，该模型可以通过简单的微调，将任意强大的预训练自回归模型（AR Pre-trained Models）转化为扩散范式。此外，引入了**块解码设计**（block-decoding design），以支持任意长度生成和KV缓存重用，从而提高推理速度。
AI.result: 1. 范式转换（从AR到扩散）非常有效。2. 将AR语言模型直接转换为dVLM是可行的，性能可与LLaVA风格的视觉指令调优模型相媲美。3. 尽管训练数据量不到先前方法的5%，DiffusionVL在MMMU-Pro (vision) 基准测试中取得了34.4%的性能提升，在MME (Cog.) 基准测试中取得了37.5%的性能提升。4. 实现了2倍的推理速度提升。
AI.translation: 在最近的多模态研究中，扩散范式（diffusion paradigm）由于其独特的解码优势，已成为自回归范式（AR）的一个有前景的替代方案。然而，由于基础扩散语言模型的能力限制，扩散视觉语言模型（dVLM）的性能仍显著落后于主流模型。这引出了一个简单而根本的问题：是否有可能基于现有的强大AR模型来构建dVLM？为此，我们提出了DiffusionVL，这是一个可以从任何强大AR模型转换而来的dVLM家族。通过简单的微调，我们成功地将AR预训练模型适配到扩散范式中。这种方法带来了两个关键观察结果：（1）从基于AR的多模态模型到扩散的范式转变非常有效。（2）将AR语言模型直接转换为dVLM也是可行的，其性能可与LLaVA风格的视觉指令调优模型相媲美。此外，我们向dVLM中引入了块解码设计，以支持任意长度生成和KV缓存重用，从而显著加快了推理速度。我们进行了大量的实验。尽管仅使用了先前方法所需数据量的不到5%进行训练，DiffusionVL仍取得了全面的性能提升——在MMMU-Pro（视觉）基准测试中提升了34.4%，在MME（认知）基准测试中提升了37.5%——同时推理速度提高了2倍。模型和代码已在https://github.com/hustvl/DiffusionVL 发布。
AI.summary: 本文提出了DiffusionVL，一种创新的方法，旨在通过简单的微调，将任何强大的自回归（AR）模型转化为高性能的扩散视觉语言模型（dVLM），以解决现有dVLM性能不足的问题。研究表明，这种范式转换是有效的，且可以直接将AR语言模型转换为具有竞争力的dVLM。通过引入块解码设计，DiffusionVL不仅在极少的训练数据下（少于5%）实现了在MMMU-Pro和MME等基准测试中超过30%的显著性能提升，还实现了2倍的推理速度加速。
AI.keywords: 扩散视觉语言模型, 自回归模型, 范式转换, 块解码, DiffusionVL
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于解决了扩散视觉语言模型（dVLM）依赖弱基础语言模型的关键瓶颈。通过提出“翻译”方法（DiffusionVL），它成功地利用了现有强大AR模型的预训练知识，从而避免了从头开始训练高性能扩散语言模型的巨大成本和难度。这种范式转换（AR到Diffusion）的有效性和可行性，对于推动扩散模型在多模态领域的应用具有重要意义。同时，该方法在大幅减少训练数据需求的同时实现了显著的性能和速度提升，展现了其极高的效率和实用性。

title: LLaDA2.0: Scaling Up Diffusion Language Models to 100B
summary: This paper presents LLaDA2.0 -- a tuple of discrete diffusion large language models (dLLM) scaling up to 100B total parameters through systematic conversion from auto-regressive (AR) models -- establishing a new paradigm for frontier-scale deployment. Instead of costly training from scratch, LLaDA2.0 upholds knowledge inheritance, progressive adaption and efficiency-aware design principle, and seamless converts a pre-trained AR model into dLLM with a novel 3-phase block-level WSD based training scheme: progressive increasing block-size in block diffusion (warm-up), large-scale full-sequence diffusion (stable) and reverting back to compact-size block diffusion (decay). Along with post-training alignment with SFT and DPO, we obtain LLaDA2.0-mini (16B) and LLaDA2.0-flash (100B), two instruction-tuned Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) variants optimized for practical deployment. By preserving the advantages of parallel decoding, these models deliver superior performance and efficiency at the frontier scale. Both models were open-sourced.

AI.title_translation: LLaDA2.0：将扩散语言模型扩展到千亿级
AI.tldr: LLaDA2.0通过系统转换预训练的自回归模型，将离散扩散语言模型（dLLM）扩展到1000亿参数。该方法使用三阶段WSD训练方案，避免了从头开始训练的成本，并产生了两个指令微调的MoE变体（16B和100B），实现了卓越的性能、效率，并已开源。
AI.motivation: 建立前沿规模部署的新范式，通过系统转换预训练的自回归模型，将离散扩散大语言模型（dLLM）扩展到1000亿参数，同时避免从头开始进行昂贵的训练。
AI.method: 采用知识继承、渐进适应和效率感知设计原则，将预训练的自回归（AR）模型无缝转换为dLLM。核心方法是新颖的3阶段块级WSD训练方案：1. 热身（在块扩散中渐进增加块大小）；2. 稳定（大规模全序列扩散）；3. 衰减（恢复到紧凑型块扩散）。之后结合SFT和DPO进行后训练对齐。
AI.result: 成功获得了两个指令微调的专家混合模型（MoE）变体：LLaDA2.0-mini (16B) 和 LLaDA2.0-flash (100B)。这些模型保留了并行解码的优势，并在前沿规模上提供了卓越的性能和效率。
AI.conclusion: 成功地通过系统转换而非从头训练，将离散扩散语言模型扩展到了1000亿参数的前沿规模，并开源了LLaDA2.0-mini和LLaDA2.0-flash模型，证明了新范式的可行性及模型的优越性能和效率。
AI.translation: 本文介绍了LLaDA2.0——一系列离散扩散大语言模型（dLLM），通过系统地从自回归（AR）模型转换，将其总参数量扩展到1000亿，从而确立了前沿规模部署的新范式。LLaDA2.0没有采用昂贵的从头训练方式，而是坚持知识继承、渐进适应和效率感知的设计原则，并通过一种新颖的3阶段块级WSD训练方案，将预训练的AR模型无缝转换为dLLM：在块扩散中渐进增加块大小（热身）、大规模全序列扩散（稳定）以及恢复到紧凑型块扩散（衰减）。结合SFT和DPO的后训练对齐，我们获得了LLaDA2.0-mini (16B) 和 LLaDA2.0-flash (100B) 这两个为实际部署而优化的指令微调专家混合模型（MoE）变体。通过保留并行解码的优势，这些模型在前沿规模上提供了卓越的性能和效率。这两个模型均已开源。
AI.summary: LLaDA2.0是一系列参数高达1000亿的离散扩散语言模型（dLLM），它通过一种新颖的系统转换方法，将预训练的自回归（AR）模型升级为dLLM，避免了从头训练的成本。该转换过程采用三阶段块级WSD训练方案，并结合SFT/DPO进行指令微调。最终成果是两个开源的MoE变体（16B和100B），它们在前沿规模上展示了优越的性能和并行解码效率。
AI.keywords: 扩散语言模型, 模型扩展, 模型转换, 专家混合模型, 并行解码
AI.comments: 本文的关键创新在于提出了一种高效且系统化的方法，将现有的预训练自回归模型（如Llama系列）转换为扩散语言模型（dLLM），从而避免了从零开始训练千亿级dLLM的巨大成本。这种“知识继承”和“渐进适应”的范式对于快速迭代和部署前沿规模的非自回归生成模型具有重要意义。特别是三阶段WSD训练方案的设计，体现了对训练效率和模型性能的平衡考量。模型采用MoE架构并保留并行解码优势，进一步突显了其对实际部署效率的重视。

title: LLM4Perf: Large Language Models Are Effective Samplers for Multi-Objective Performance Modeling
summary: The performance of modern software systems is critically dependent on their complex configuration options. Building accurate performance models to navigate this vast space requires effective sampling strategies, yet existing methods often struggle with multi-objective optimization and cannot leverage semantic information from documentation. The recent success of Large Language Models (LLMs) motivates the central question of this work: Can LLMs serve as effective samplers for multi-objective performance modeling? To explore this, we present a comprehensive empirical study investigating the capabilities and characteristics of LLM-driven sampling. We design and implement LLM4Perf, a feedback-based framework, and use it to systematically evaluate the LLM-guided sampling process across four highly configurable, real-world systems. Our study reveals that the LLM-guided approach outperforms traditional baselines in most cases. Quantitatively, LLM4Perf achieves the best performance in nearly 68.8% (77 out of 112) of all evaluation scenarios, demonstrating its superior effectiveness. We find this effectiveness stems from the LLM's dual capabilities of configuration space pruning and feedback-driven strategy refinement. The effectiveness of this pruning is further validated by the fact that it also improves the performance of the baseline methods in nearly 91.5% (410 out of 448) of cases. Furthermore, we show how the LLM choices for each component and hyperparameters within LLM4Perf affect its effectiveness. Overall, this paper provides strong evidence for the effectiveness of LLMs in performance engineering and offers concrete insights into the mechanisms that drive their success.

AI.title_translation: LLM4Perf：大型语言模型是多目标性能建模的有效采样器
AI.tldr: LLM4Perf是一个新框架，它使用大型语言模型（LLM）作为采样器，用于复杂软件系统的多目标性能建模。它通过配置空间修剪和反馈细化，在68.8%的评估场景中优于传统基线方法。
AI.motivation: 现代软件系统的性能严重依赖于复杂的配置选项。构建准确的性能模型需要有效的采样策略，但现有方法难以处理多目标优化，且无法利用文档中的语义信息。本文的核心问题是：LLM能否作为多目标性能建模的有效采样器？
AI.method: 设计并实现了LLM4Perf，这是一个基于反馈的框架。通过一个全面的实证研究，系统地评估了LLM引导的采样过程，并将其应用于四个高度可配置的真实世界系统。
AI.result: LLM引导的方法（LLM4Perf）在大多数情况下优于传统基线。在所有评估场景中，LLM4Perf在近68.8%（112个中的77个）的情况下取得了最佳性能。这种有效性源于LLM配置空间修剪和反馈驱动策略细化的双重能力。此外，修剪操作还将基线方法的性能提高了近91.5%（448个中的410个）。
AI.conclusion: 本文为LLM在性能工程中的有效性提供了强有力的证据，并提供了关于驱动其成功的机制的具体见解。
AI.translation: 现代软件系统的性能严重依赖于其复杂的配置选项。构建准确的性能模型以驾驭这个广阔的空间需要有效的采样策略，但现有方法通常难以处理多目标优化，并且无法利用文档中的语义信息。大型语言模型（LLM）最近的成功激发了这项工作的核心问题：LLM能否作为多目标性能建模的有效采样器？为了探索这一点，我们提出了一个全面的实证研究，调查LLM驱动采样的能力和特点。我们设计并实现了LLM4Perf，这是一个基于反馈的框架，并用它来系统地评估LLM引导的采样过程，将其应用于四个高度可配置的真实世界系统。我们的研究表明，LLM引导的方法在大多数情况下优于传统基线。从定量上看，LLM4Perf在近68.8%（112个中的77个）的所有评估场景中取得了最佳性能，证明了其卓越的有效性。我们发现这种有效性源于LLM配置空间修剪和反馈驱动策略细化的双重能力。修剪的有效性进一步得到验证，因为它还将基线方法的性能提高了近91.5%（448个中的410个）的情况。此外，我们展示了LLM4Perf中用于每个组件的LLM选择和超参数如何影响其有效性。总而言之，本文为LLM在性能工程中的有效性提供了强有力的证据，并提供了关于驱动其成功的机制的具体见解。
AI.summary: 本文提出了LLM4Perf，这是一个基于反馈的框架，利用大型语言模型（LLM）作为有效的采样器，用于复杂软件系统的多目标性能建模。通过对四个真实世界系统的实证研究表明，LLM4Perf在大多数评估场景中显著优于传统基线，并在68.8%的场景中取得了最佳性能。其成功归因于LLM配置空间修剪和基于反馈细化采样策略的能力，这为LLM在性能工程中的应用提供了强有力的证据。
AI.keywords: 大型语言模型, 性能建模, 多目标优化, 采样, 配置空间
AI.comments: 创新点在于将大型语言模型（LLM）定位为智能采样器，而不仅仅是自然语言处理工具。它解决了传统采样方法在处理复杂软件系统的多目标优化和利用语义信息（如文档）方面的不足。通过引入配置空间修剪和反馈驱动策略细化的双重机制，LLM4Perf显著提升了性能建模的效率和准确性。这项工作为将LLM应用于性能工程领域提供了一个新颖且强有力的范例。

title: Hearing to Translate: The Effectiveness of Speech Modality Integration into LLMs
summary: As Large Language Models (LLMs) expand beyond text, integrating speech as a native modality has given rise to SpeechLLMs, which aim to translate spoken language directly, thereby bypassing traditional transcription-based pipelines. Whether this integration improves speech-to-text translation quality over established cascaded architectures, however, remains an open question. We present Hearing to Translate, the first comprehensive test suite rigorously benchmarking 5 state-of-the-art SpeechLLMs against 16 strong direct and cascade systems that couple leading speech foundation models (SFM), with multilingual LLMs. Our analysis spans 16 benchmarks, 13 language pairs, and 9 challenging conditions, including disfluent, noisy, and long-form speech. Across this extensive evaluation, we find that cascaded systems remain the most reliable overall, while current SpeechLLMs only match cascades in selected settings and SFMs lag behind both, highlighting that integrating an LLM, either within the model or in a pipeline, is essential for high-quality speech translation.

AI.title_translation: 倾听以翻译：语音模态集成到大型语言模型中的有效性
AI.tldr: 本文首次全面评估了语音大模型 (SpeechLLMs) 与级联系统在语音翻译中的性能。结果显示，级联系统（结合语音基础模型和多语言大模型）目前仍是最可靠的，而端到端语音大模型仅在特定场景下能与之匹敌。
AI.motivation: 评估将语音作为原生模态集成到大型语言模型中（形成SpeechLLMs）是否能比传统的基于转录的级联架构更好地提高语音到文本翻译的质量。
AI.method: 提出了首个综合测试套件“Hearing to Translate”，严格评估了5个最先进的SpeechLLMs，并将其与16个强大的直接和级联系统（结合领先的语音基础模型SFM和多语言LLM）进行基准测试。评估涵盖16个基准、13种语言对和9种挑战性条件（包括不流利、嘈杂和长篇语音）。
AI.result: 级联系统总体上仍然是最可靠的。当前的SpeechLLMs仅在特定设置中能与级联系统匹配。纯语音基础模型（SFMs）则落后于前两者。
AI.conclusion: 无论是将大型语言模型集成到模型内部（SpeechLLM）还是集成到管道中（级联系统），对于实现高质量的语音翻译都是至关重要的。
